SUMMARY:
<summary>
This webpage (from China's National Development and Reform Commission, authored by the Price and Cost Survey Center) analyzes the current characteristics of China's population aging and its implications for expanding domestic demand.

MAIN CONTEXT: With rising economic complexity and uncertainty, the Chinese government is focusing on ensuring and improving people's livelihoods. The 7th National Population Census shows China's 60+ population reached 264 million (264.02 million, 18.7% of population), with 65+ at 190.64 million (13.5%). The 60+ population is projected to exceed 300 million during the "14th Five-Year Plan" period (by 2025), reach 400 million by 2033, and peak at 487 million by 2053. It is expected that China will transition from a mild-to-moderate aging society during the "14th Five-Year Plan" period.

SECTION 1 - CHARACTERISTICS OF POPULATION AGING:
1. Large elderly population with accelerating growth: China has the most elderly people in the world.
2. Worsening empty-nest phenomenon: By late "14th Five-Year Plan," the "post-60s" generation will make up about 28% of the elderly. In 2020, empty-nest and solitary elderly reached 118 million. Family caregiving functions are weakening as children provide mostly financial support rather than physical care.
3. Increasing care burden: In 2021, the elderly dependency ratio was 21.1% (up 1.4% from 2020). By 2035 it is projected to exceed 50%, meaning two young people will need to support one elderly person. In 2020, the urban workers' basic pension insurance fund had a gap of 692.5 billion yuan (income: 4,437.57 billion; expenditures: 5,130.14 billion), with the first negative growth in cumulative pension balance.
4. Growing health awareness: Over 180 million elderly Chinese suffer from chronic diseases; 75% have one or more chronic conditions. Demand for professional nursing, rehabilitation, and health management services is large and rigid.
5. Rising elderly internet use: As of December 2021, there were 119 million elderly netizens (60+, 11.5% of all netizens), with 43.2% internet penetration among 60+. In January 2022, monthly active users among elderly grew 43.3% on Taobao, 31.8% on Pinduoduo, 50.3% on JD, and 109.3% on Taote.
6. Higher educational attainment and cultural consumption: 36.69 million people aged 60+ have high school education or above (up 20.85 million from 2010). In 2020, urban-rural elderly per capita consumption was about 16,307 yuan, with social/entertainment spending at 13% (above the national average of 10.8%).

SECTION 2 - INVESTMENT AND CONSUMPTION DEMAND FROM AGING:
1. Institutional elderly care market: As of end-2020, only 31 beds per 1,000 elderly people aged 60+. The "14th Five-Year Plan" targets 9 million beds by 2025 (currently 8.21 million), requiring about 800,000 new beds. At 5,000 yuan/bed/month, the 2025 institutional care market is projected at 540 billion yuan.
2. Commercial pension insurance: The pension system relies on the first pillar (~70% share). China's pension gap is projected at 8-10 trillion yuan over 5-10 years. By contrast, US first-pillar pension share is 7.1%, second and third pillars 92.9%. Capital market pensions account for 20-30% in developed countries vs. about 1% in China.
3. Home medical devices: By 2025, China is expected to become the world's largest medical device market (~266 billion USD, ~1.4 trillion yuan). As of 2020, China's market was only 772.1 billion yuan (~22% of global market).
4. Online shopping: Elderly internet penetration (43.2%) still lags the national rate (73%). Silver users' online spending had a 20.9% three-year compound growth rate; during the pandemic, their spending growth ranked second only to "post-00s."
5. Age-friendly renovation and smart homes: About 40 million elderly fall at least once annually, about half at home. Nearly 60% of urban and rural elderly consider housing "not age-friendly." Retrofitting China's existing 40 billion sqm of old buildings for aging needs is estimated at 15 trillion yuan, with home renovation directly worth ~3 trillion yuan. Smart home products shipped 215 million units in 2020, projected to reach 610 million by 2024.
6. Elderly cultural entertainment: Elderly consumption potential is projected to grow to 106 trillion yuan by 2050. By 2030, the elderly education/culture/entertainment market could reach 11 trillion yuan.

SECTION 3 - POLICY RECOMMENDATIONS:
1. Build diversified elderly care service supply: Create a "15-minute elderly care service circle" providing meals, emergency help, medical assistance, bathing, mobility aid, and cleaning; open the elderly care market to social capital with a system of "basic security, affordable choices, and distinctive supply."
2. Improve the multi-tiered pension insurance system: Following the April 21 policy on personal pension development, formulate supporting rules for personal pension investment, convert resident savings into long-term capital market funds, and develop innovative elderly financial products (pension wealth management, dedicated pension insurance, commercial pensions).
3. Combine "old renovation" and "new infrastructure": Retrofit existing residential communities and homes for aging needs, boost the home adaptation market, and accelerate digital "new infrastructure" applications in elderly care with age-friendly design as a key indicator.
4. Enable elderly "smart living": Use big data to identify diverse needs and offer customized products; support internet companies in developing age-friendly technologies; expand cultural consumption scenarios through online-offline integration; and strengthen market supervision to improve the quality of elderly products and optimize the consumption environment.

Key referenced policies include the April 25 State Council opinion on releasing consumption potential and promoting continuous consumption recovery, which calls for boosting health and elderly care service consumption; and the April 21 State Council opinion on promoting personal pension development.
</summary>

- GDP growth forecast for 2024 is 4.8% (up 0.3pp from December forecast), slowing to 4.1% average in 2025-26. CPI inflation forecast at 0.9% for 2024.

This RICS news article (published April 29, 2026) analyzes how China's 15th Five-Year Plan (2026–2030) drives a strategic transformation of the real estate and construction industries, featuring analysis from Shaun Brodie FRICS, a member of the RICS China Regional Advisory Board.

**Strategic Positioning:** The Plan marks a fundamental shift from "scale expansion" to "quality enhancement," from factor-driven to innovation-led growth, and from fragmented to systemic coordination. Notably, real estate is elevated to the strategic priority of "ensuring and improving people's livelihoods" rather than being embedded in urbanization frameworks. A key policy change establishes that new construction land will in principle no longer be allocated for commercial real estate development, ending the land-driven expansion model and beginning a stock asset management era. Local governments must transition from the "land transfer–development–sales–fiscal recycling" model toward diversified fiscal structures incorporating industrial development and equity-based financing.

**Real Estate Sector Implications:**
1. Housing support reform focuses on optimizing affordable housing supply, full-cycle management, dynamic rental-ownership conversion, and deepening housing provident fund reform (expanding access to flexible/non-traditional workers). Implementation follows a "region–population–product" framework.
2. Market stability relies on institutional innovation including the project company system and lead bank financing model, promotion of ready-built housing sales, and land supply reform aligned with population dynamics and inventory, creating a "people, housing, land, and capital" coordination mechanism. Urban regeneration (age-friendly retrofits, smart upgrades) and jobs-housing balance are emphasized.
3. "Quality homes" delivery focuses on "safe, comfortable, green, and intelligent" housing, with a full lifecycle risk management framework including building inspection, maintenance funding, and insurance. A dual-track housing safety fund mechanism (individual + public accounts) is introduced.

**Green Transformation and Value Creation:**
1. Green building evolves from new supply to stock transformation, with carbon policy shifting from intensity-based targets to dual control of total emissions and intensity. Zero-carbon industrial parks and buildings are national priorities. Shanghai examples show multinational occupiers prioritizing buildings with transparent lifecycle carbon data, while domestic firms align with ESG investment strategies.
2. Rental market reform emphasizes controlling new development, reducing inventory, and improving quality, including converting commercial housing into affordable rental stock. Public REITs expand to commercial real estate, creating an "infrastructure + commercial property" dual-track model. Valuation shifts to operational performance, tenant experience, and sustainability credentials, with high-carbon assets facing obsolescence risk.
3. Full lifecycle carbon management becomes an operational imperative (monitoring emissions across design/construction/operations, low-carbon materials, renewable energy, smart building solutions). Sustainability investments are viewed as value-accretive. Green bonds and sustainability-linked loans require measurable carbon reduction outcomes, including embodied carbon and Scope 3 emissions, with strong carbon performers enjoying better financing conditions.

**Conclusion:** The Plan is a decisive turning point, redefining industry fundamentals through institutional, technological, and business model innovation. For industry participants it presents strategic opportunities to enhance operational capabilities; for society it promises improved housing quality, sustainable urban environments, and a more resilient housing system.
</summary>

1. POLICY SHIFT TOWARD LIVELIHOOD SECURITY: The Plan states that over the next five years, real estate policy will shift toward safeguarding people's livelihoods, while also focusing on enhancing living quality to meet residents' demand for "living well" (住得好). It calls for accelerating the construction of a new real estate development model, improving a housing system with multiple entities supplying housing and multiple channels of security, and promoting both rental and purchase options for higher-level housing attainment.

2. 3. Experts said the key is to adhere to the principles of "steady progress" and "establishing before abolishing," piloting in mature cities or projects before gradual promotion.

Key keyword: 居住要"安心" (residential safety/peace of mind)—emphasizing dilapidated building governance, residential safety, steady advancement of urban village redevelopment, and multi-channel construction of affordable housing so both old community residents and first-time homebuyers can live securely.

--- SOURCE 3: 人口负增长 ---
URL: https://baike.baidu.com/item/人口负增长/2538712

SUMMARY:
<summary>
人口负增长（英文：Population Decline）是指某一地区在一定时间（通常为一年）内人口死亡率高于人口生育率，人口自然增长呈负值状态的人口现象。该现象并非意味着社会人口问题的终结，而是呈现出更加复杂的特征。

**关键历史时间线：**
- 1971-1988年：全球人口增长率先是小幅下降；1989年起呈缓慢下降趋势
- 1993年：上海市成为中国第一个人口负增长的省区市
- 2017年：中国共有六个省区市的常住人口增量进入负增长区间
- 2018年：中国全年出生人口仅1523万，比2017年减少200万
- 2020年底：韩国登记人口5182.9万人，死亡人口数（307764人）超过新生人口数（275815人），韩国首次出现人口负增长
- 2022年：联合国《世界人口展望2022》提出世界人口将在2087年开始负增长
- 2022年：中国总人口141175万人，比上年末减少85万人，人口自然增长率为-0.60‰，是自1962年以来中国人口首次出现负增长
- 2023年：延续负增长态势；联合国宣布保加利亚是全球人口下降最快的国家
- 2024年11月5日：日本政府发布2024年上半年新生儿人口数据，较2023年同期减少约6%；日本2024年1至6月新生儿为329998人，比同期减少6.3%。日本媒体预期2024年全年新生儿将首次少于70万（2023年约72.7万，连续八年创新低）

**人口负增长特点：** 具有隐蔽性、渐进性、累积性、爆发性和长期性。

**对中国经济的影响：**
人口负增长不仅会使劳动力规模减少，还带来少子化、老龄化等人口结构变化，影响劳动力供给、资本积累、消费需求扩大及技术创新，给经济增长带来不利影响。冲击主要表现在供给侧（劳动力稀缺性与成本上升、储蓄率与投资率下降、驱动力转向创新与技术进步）和需求侧（需求收缩、供给冲击、预期转弱三重冲击）。

**数据调查要点（中国发展研究基金会2012年报告）：**
- 中国2012年已进入低出生率、低死亡率阶段，人口红利期已结束
- 第六次人口普查推算总和生育率为1.18，综合出生率应在1.5以下
- 2027年中国人口将转为负增长（按当时趋势预测）
- 20-29岁生育旺盛期妇女2011年达到1.04亿顶峰后快速减少，到2020年、2030年分别只有0.82亿、0.63亿
- 学者指出未来将出现几十年人口"泄洪"期，每年净减少一千多万人

**山东长岛县案例：**
长岛县作为中国唯一在1985年"海岛会议"正式放开二胎政策的海岛县，生育政策放开虽有短暂反弹（1986-1988年平均每年800-1000个新生儿），但此后持续负增长。2009年人口出生率和自然增长率分别为4.27‰和-0.92‰，2013年时年均新生儿维持在不到200人/年。当地通过新渔合医疗优惠（放弃二胎家庭享受20%个人医疗保险费用减免）、物质奖励（独女户奖励200元）、宅基地分配优先等利益导向政策，反而促成了人口"自觉"调整。

**学者观点：**
- 中国人口变动面临的主要风险已从人口数量过大和增长过快，转向持续负增长、极低生育率与快速老龄化
- 未来30年仍有新人口机遇：2050年人口仍在13亿以上，人力资本成为经济高质量发展新动力源
- 人口负增长不能简单以好坏形容，需要客观看待、主动适应、积极应对
- 国际经验显示应通过鼓励生育、吸纳国际移民、发展教育提升人力资本、积极应对人口老龄化等措施对冲影响
- 应对策略应着力完善与生育政策配套的就业政策、教育政策、老龄政策、托幼政策等经济社会政策

**负增长国家（词条标注）：** 中国、日本、德国、意大利等。

Enterprise Landscape: The number of large developers shrank significantly—only 11 "billion-yuan" developers remained in 2024 (down 30 from 2020). SUMMARY:
<summary>
This academic article, published in July 2025 in the journal "Management Science and Engineering" (管理科学与工程, Vol. 14, No. 4, pp. 845-852), examines how prefabricated buildings can lead green construction in modern new Hunan Province under China's "dual carbon" goals (carbon peak by 2030 and carbon neutrality) and Hunan's "Three Highlands and Four New Missions" strategy. Authored by Jia Guo, Junping Zhong, Dan Zhang, Yukui Wang, and Hao Long from Hunan City University's College of Civil Engineering, the study was funded by the Hunan Provincial Social Science Achievement Review Committee (project XSP24YBC441).

KEY FINDINGS AND CONTEXT:
- Hunan has been a national prefabricated building demonstration province since 2016, with a "one core, multiple poles" development pattern centered on Changsha, hosting leading enterprises like Yuanda Housing and Sany Construction. Annual production capacity exceeds 30 million square meters. In 2023, prefabricated buildings accounted for 35% of new construction (above the national average of 25%); Xiangtan City's share reached 37.2% in 2023 and 54.1% in the first half of 2024.
- Hunan's "14th Five-Year Plan" targets prefabricated buildings reaching over 40% of new construction by 2025, supported by subsidies of 100-200 yuan per square meter and land transfer priority.

CORE CONTRADICTIONS IDENTIFIED:
1. Green vs. economic imbalance: Initial costs are 10-15% higher than traditional cast-in-place construction (mold costs 2-3 million yuan per project; transport radius limited to ≤50 km). Long-term benefits (30% lower operational energy, 25% lower maintenance costs) take 10-15 years to materialize.
2. Industrial chain fragmentation: PC factory-to-site qualified part rate is only 85% (vs. 95% for traditional); Hunan's construction mechanization rate is 65% (vs. Shanghai's 85%). Design standardization is poor, with single projects having over 50 component types.
3. Policy-market dual constraints: Government projects account for 65% of prefabricated projects; subsidies are "universalized" without linking to emission reductions; cross-departmental coordination is lacking. Local material supply is limited (regional steel supply only 40%).

FOUR-DIMENSIONAL SOLUTION PATH (policy innovation, technological breakthrough, industrial upgrading, cost optimization):
- Policy: Differentiated "technology-emission reduction" dual subsidies (+50 yuan/m² for low-carbon technologies like steel/wood-bamboo structures), carbon trading integration (estimated 200,000-300,000 yuan annual revenue per project), 1-2% floor area ratio incentives, green credit loans 15% below benchmark rates, and issuance of 10 local technical standards by 2025.
- Technology: Establish a Hunan Prefabricated Building Low-Carbon Technology Research Institute focusing on fireproofing/insulation integration (fire resistance ≥2.5 hours, sound insulation ≥50 dB), regenerated aggregate concrete (usage ≥40%), and BIPV integration (15% building energy self-sufficiency). Mandate "fewer specifications, more combinations" design with a standard component library (200 generic components) to raise mold reuse to 70%. Build BIM+IoT smart construction platforms.
- Industry: Cultivate "chain-leading enterprises" for vertical integration, develop 10 provincial "specialized and innovative" SMEs by 2025, create a Changsha-Zhuzhou-Xiangtan prefabricated building industrial cluster with a "1-hour supporting industry circle" (30% transport cost reduction), and expand public building applications (≥80% in government projects, 50 provincial green demonstration projects).
- Cost: Establish life-cycle cost accounting guidelines—for a 100,000 m² residential project, initial cost increase of 12 million yuan is recovered in 8-10 years via operational savings; "design-stage cost locking" and green credit evaluation systems, plus "prefabricated building+" value-added models (5-8% sales price premium).

CONCLUSION: The study demonstrates that coordinated policy guidance, technological innovation, industrial collaboration, and market-driven forces can break through "technology-economy-policy" barriers, transforming prefabricated buildings from "policy-dependent" to "endogenous growth" mode. It provides an actionable path for Hunan's green construction and offers a localized model reference for similar regions nationwide.

Five principles are outlined: 1) Overall deployment with classified implementation (总体部署、分类施策); 2) Systematic advancement with key breakthroughs (系统推进、重点突破); 3) Dual-wheel drive with government and market forces (双轮驱动、两手发力); 4) Steady, orderly, and safe progress in decarbonization (稳妥有序、安全降碳), considering China's energy endowment of being rich in coal, poor in oil, and limited in gas.

- During the 14th Five-Year Plan period (2021-2025): By 2025, non-fossil energy consumption share should reach ~20%; energy consumption per unit of GDP should fall 13.5% from 2020 levels; CO2 emissions per unit of GDP should fall 18% from 2020 levels.
- During the 15th Five-Year Plan period (2026-2030): By 2030, non-fossil energy consumption share should reach ~25%; CO2 emissions per unit of GDP should fall over 65% from 2005 levels; achieving the primary goal of peaking carbon emissions before 2030.

**Ten Key Actions (碳达峰十大行动):** The plan implements "Ten Carbon Peak Actions" including: 1) Green and low-carbon energy transition; 2) Energy conservation and carbon reduction; 3) Industrial sector carbon peak; 4) Urban-rural construction carbon peak; 5) Green low-carbon transportation; 6) Circular economy to aid carbon reduction; 7) Green low-carbon technology innovation; 8) Carbon sink capacity consolidation and enhancement; 9) Green low-carbon action for all; 10) Regional tiered and orderly carbon peak actions.

**Key details under the actions include:**

- Industry: Deepen steel supply-side reform, prohibit new capacity; strictly control new cement clinker and flat glass capacity; by 2025, domestic crude oil primary processing capacity controlled within 1 billion tons; firmly curb blind development of "two high" projects (high energy consumption and high emissions).
- Construction: By 2025, all new urban buildings must implement green building standards; renewable energy substitution rate in urban buildings should reach 8%; photovoltaic coverage on roofs of new public buildings and factories should strive for 50%.
- Transportation: By 2030, ~40% of newly added transportation vehicles should use new/clean energy; carbon emission intensity per converted turnover unit for operating vehicles down ~9.5% from 2020; national railway comprehensive energy consumption per converted turnover unit down 10% from 2020; road transport oil consumption to peak before 2030; cities with over 1 million residents should have green travel ratio of no less than 70%; container rail-water intermodal transport volume growing over 15% annually during the 14th Five-Year Plan period.

- Carbon sinks: By 2030, national forest coverage rate reaching ~25% with forest stock volume of 19 billion cubic meters (190亿立方米).
- Regional: Select 100 representative cities and parks for carbon peak pilot construction.

**International Cooperation:** Deep participation in global climate governance upholding the principle of common but differentiated responsibilities; green trade, technology, and financial cooperation; advancing green "Belt and Road" construction.

**Policy Safeguards:** Establish a unified and standardized carbon emission statistics and accounting system; improve laws, regulations, and standards; improve economic policies (including green taxation, pricing, and finance tools such as green loans, green bonds, and a carbon reduction support tool); establish and improve market mechanisms including the national carbon emissions trading market and energy use rights trading market.

**Implementation:** Strengthen unified coordination under the Carbon Peak and Carbon Neutrality Work Leading Group; reinforce accountability; implement monitoring and assessment with a system focused primarily on carbon intensity control supplemented by total carbon emission control, integrating results into central and provincial ecological environment protection inspections.

This webpage from China Energy Portal presents the translated text of the State Council's "Action Plan for Peaking Carbon Emissions Before 2030" (Document No. 23, issued October 24, 2021). This is China's key policy document outlining how it will achieve its carbon dioxide peaking goal before 2030 as part of its broader carbon neutrality commitment.

**Overall Requirements and Guiding Principles:** The Plan emphasizes balancing development with emissions reduction, exercising nationwide planning, prioritizing conservation, leveraging both government and market strengths, and safely reducing carbon emissions ("construction before destruction" given China's coal-rich, oil/gas-poor resource profile). It stresses incorporating carbon peaking goals into economic and social development while safeguarding energy, food, and industrial chain security.

**Main Objectives:**
- By 2025: Non-fossil fuels to reach ~20% of energy consumption; energy consumption per unit of GDP to drop 13.5% and CO2 emissions per unit of GDP to drop 18% vs. 2020 levels.
- By 2030: Non-fossil energy consumption to reach ~25%; CO2 emissions per unit of GDP to drop by over 65% vs. 2005 levels, achieving carbon peaking before 2030.

**Ten Key Actions (Key Targets):**
1. **Green and Low-Carbon Energy Transition:** Cut coal consumption growth during 14th FYP and phase down in 15th FYP; new power transmission lines to carry at least 50% renewable electricity; wind and solar capacity to exceed 1,200 GW by 2030; ~40 GW additional hydro capacity in each 14th and 15th FYP period; orderly nuclear power development; by 2025, 30+ GW of new energy storage; by 2030, ~120 GW pumped-storage hydro capacity and provincial grids to have 5%+ peak load response capacity.
2. **Energy Saving and Efficiency:** Implement conservation-first policy with dual controls on energy volume and intensity; energy-saving retrofits for cities, industrial parks, and key industries (steel, nonferrous metals, building materials, petrochemicals).
3. **Industry Sector Peaking:** Steel, nonferrous metals, building materials, and petrochemical sectors to undergo green transformation; by 2025, domestic crude oil primary processing capacity capped at 1 billion tons; strict curb on "two high" (high energy consumption/high emission) projects.
4. **Urban-Rural Development:** By 2025, all new urban buildings to comply with green building standards; urban building renewable energy substitution rate to reach 8%; rooftop PV coverage on new public and factory buildings to reach 50%; promote "PV + storage + DC + flexible load" buildings.
5. **Green Transport:** By 2030, ~40% of new vehicles to be new energy/clean energy powered; transport carbon intensity per unit turnover down ~9.5% vs. 2020; railway energy intensity down 10%; road transport oil consumption to peak before 2030; container rail-water intermodal volume to grow 15%+ annually during 14th FYP.
6. **Circular Economy:** By 2025, bulk solid waste annual utilization ~4 billion tons (4.5 billion by 2030); nine major recyclable resources (scrap steel, copper, aluminum, lead, zinc, paper, plastic, rubber, glass) to reach 450 million tons by 2025 and 510 million by 2030; by 2025, municipal waste recycling rate ~60%, rising to 65% by 2030 with full waste sorting coverage.
7. **Green Tech Innovation:** Establish national labs and special R&D programs for carbon peaking/neutrality technology; focus on large-scale renewables, new power systems, hydrogen, energy storage, and CO2 capture, utilization and storage (CCUS).
8. **Carbon Sink Enhancement:** By 2030, national forest coverage ~25% with forest volume of 19 billion cubic meters; protect and restore forests, grasslands, wetlands, mangroves, seagrass beds, and salt marshes.
9. **Green Society: Nationwide:** Ecological education, green lifestyles, corporate social responsibility (key state-owned enterprises to publish carbon reduction plans and disclose carbon emission information), and cadre training.
10. **Regional Hierarchical Peaking:** Regions with stable emissions should reduce further; select 100 representative cities and industrial parks for carbon peaking pilot projects; provinces to formulate local action plans avoiding "one-size-fits-all" power cuts or campaign-style carbon reduction.

**International Cooperation:** Deep participation in global climate governance under the UNFCCC and Paris Agreement (common but differentiated responsibilities); green trade, technology and finance cooperation (including CCUS and international science projects like ITER); and promotion of green "Belt and Road" construction.

**Implementation:** All regions, ministries and institutions must implement the Plan carefully, with implementation incorporated into central and provincial ecological/environmental protection inspections.
</summary>

URL: http://www.xinhuanet.com/politics/20240123/430c2ef4a4144890a21a3c4656ca2867/c.html

SUMMARY:
<summary>
This is a Xinhua News article (published January 23, 2024, sourced from China Youth Daily) reporting on China's first-ever policy document dedicated to the "silver economy" (银发经济), titled "Opinions on Developing the Silver Economy and Enhancing the Welfare of the Elderly" (《关于发展银发经济增进老年人福祉的意见》), issued by the State Council.

Key facts:
- The document proposes integrating next-generation information technology, mobile terminals, wearable devices, and service robots into elderly care settings (home, community, institutional), and developing smart products for health management, elderly care monitoring, and psychological comfort.
- China's elderly population: as of end of 2023, over 297 million people aged 60+, with over 217 million aged 65+, making China the country with the world's largest elderly population.
- The Fudan University Institute of Aging Research's "China Silver Economy Development Research Report" projects the silver economy will reach 19 trillion yuan by 2035, accounting for 28% of total consumption and 9.6% of GDP.
- The Ministry of Industry and Information Technology reports China's elderly products market reached 5 trillion yuan in 2023.
- The document includes 26 measures across four aspects, addressing seven urgent elderly needs (elderly meal services, home care assistance, community convenience services, elderly health services, care services, cultural/sports services, rural elderly care) and cultivating seven potential industries.
- The policy includes land use guarantees (new residential areas must allocate no less than 0.1 square meters per person for community elderly care facilities; counties with moderate or higher aging levels should raise this standard), and financial support via special re-lending loans for inclusive elderly care institutions.
- This follows prior mentions of the silver economy in the 14th Five-Year Plan, the "Expanding Domestic Demand Strategic Planning Outline (2022-2035)," the 20th Central Financial and Economic Affairs Commission's first meeting (May 2023), and the 2023 Central Economic Work Conference.

Expert perspectives cited:
- Liu Ming (Director of the Social Development Department, National Development and Reform Commission): "Every family has elderly members, and everyone will grow old; the current needs of the elderly will be the future needs of young people."
- Hu Zuquan (Director of the Population Office, National Information Center Forecasting Department): Silver economy is important to national affairs given it involves nearly 300 million people; the consensus among service robot companies is that elderly care is a key application scenario for service robots.
- Chen Gong (Director/Professor, Institute of Population Research, Peking University): Identifies supply-demand mismatch issues in inclusive elderly care—gaps between public and private institutions, and urban-rural mismatches; recommends neighborhood mutual aid, time banks (points savings), and rural facility improvements. Notes Guangdong province's wheelchair and smart hospital bed products account for 50-60% of domestic market share and 70% of national exports.
- Yuan Xin (Professor, Nankai University, Director of Aging Development Strategy Research Center): The silver economy has risen from concept to action as an important strategy for actively addressing population aging, expanding domestic demand, and achieving high-quality development.
- Hu Zuquan also suggests promoting barrier-free construction and age-friendly adaptation not just physically but across economic and social environments, and introduces the concept of "longevity economy" as a related term.
</summary>

--- SOURCE 2: 发展银发经济 - 求是网 ---
URL: https://www.qstheory.cn/20250828/5cfee7459ac34ffa81bf483a41ba2bdd/c.html

SUMMARY:
<summary>
This article, titled "发展银发经济" (Developing the Silver Economy), was published in 《红旗文稿》 (Red Flag Manuscript) 2025/16 by author 郑秉文 (Zheng Bingwen), a researcher at the Chinese Academy of Social Sciences, on August 28, 2025. It examines China's aging population trends, the policy history of the silver economy, its significance, and its policy framework.

**Population Aging Trends:**
- China entered an aging society in 2001 when those aged 65+ reached 90.62 million (7.1% of population).
- By 2021, 65+ population exceeded 200 million (14.2%), marking deep aging.
- UN forecasts project China will enter a "super-aging society" by 2032 when 65+ population reaches 278 million (over 20% of total).
- Birth rates have fallen continuously from 17.86 million (2016) to 10.62 million (2021); population entered negative growth in 2022 (down 850,000), declining by 2.08 million in 2023 and 1.39 million in 2024.
- Population projected to decline from 1.408 billion (2024) to 1.376 billion (2035) and 1.265 billion (2050).
- Old-age dependency ratio (65+/15-64) rose from 10.1% (2001) to 22.8% (2024), projected to reach 33.7% (2035) and 52.3% (2050).

**Policy History:**
- 1984: First national aging work conference set aging work goals.
- 1996: 《老年人权益保障法》 (Law on Protection of Rights and Interests of the Elderly) proposed developing aging services.
- 2000: Party and State Council decision on strengthening aging work.
- 2006: White Paper on China's Aging Services Development.
- 2013/2016/2021: Implementation of separate two-child, universal two-child, and three-child policies.
- 2019: National Medium and Long-term Plan for Actively Responding to Population Aging.
- 19th CPC Central Committee Fifth Plenary Session elevated responding to aging to a national strategy.
- 2024 January: State Council issued first formal definition of silver economy with 26 specific tasks.
- 2025 March: Consumption stimulus plan released, proposing to unlock silver consumption market potential.

**Significance:**
1. Important support for Chinese-style modernization.
2. Key force for boosting consumption and expanding domestic demand: pension recipients grew from 205 million (2012, 15.1% of population) to 328 million (2024, 23.3%); pension spending grew from 1.67 trillion yuan (3.2% of GDP) to 7.3 trillion yuan (5.4% of GDP).
3. Important pathway for cultivating new quality productive forces (新质生产力).
4. Strategic measure to address population aging—aging is "trend-based, not temporary; a new normal, not abnormal."
5. Necessary choice for improving elderly welfare.

**Policy Framework:**
- Combines "serving the elderly economy" (为老经济) and "preparing for old age economy" (备老经济), noting the EU defines silver economy as economic opportunities from public and consumer spending related to needs of those 50+.
- Includes both elderly welfare services (养老事业, government-led) and elderly industry (养老产业, market-oriented), forming a Chinese-characteristic silver economy system.
- By 2025, basic elderly care service system to be fully established covering all elderly; by 2029, elderly care service network basically complete; by 2035, all elderly enjoy basic elderly care services.
- 20+ provinces have issued local regulations on elderly care services.
- Elderly industry covers three levels: urgent needs (meal assistance, home care, community services, health, long-term care), product supply expansion, and cultivating potential industries (smart health, rehabilitation devices, anti-aging, elderly finance, tourism, aging-friendly renovation).
</summary>

"发展银发经济不仅是提振消费、扩大国内需求、推动高质量发展的重要增长极，还是培育新质生产力的重要途径。" (Developing the silver economy is not only an important growth pole for boosting consumption, expanding domestic demand, and promoting high-quality development, but also an important pathway for cultivating new quality productive forces.)

SUMMARY:
<summary>
This is an opinion/analysis article published on China.com.cn (中国网) on March 25, 2026, originally sourced from 上观新闻 (Shanghai Observer News), authored by an individual from Shanghai University of Finance and Economics (上海财经大学). The article discusses the transformation of China's approach to elder care from "养老" (passive eldercare/being cared for) to "享老" (actively enjoying old age), and the emergence of the "silver economy" (银发经济) as a major economic opportunity.

Key facts and statistics:
- As of the end of 2025, China's population aged 60+ reached 320 million (3.2亿), accounting for 23.0% of the total population, marking China's entry into a moderately aging society.
- China's silver economy is currently estimated at approximately 7 trillion yuan (约7万亿元), about 6% of GDP.
- By 2035, the silver economy is projected to reach 30 trillion yuan (30万亿元), potentially accounting for 10% of GDP.
- In 2025, China's senior tourism market reached 789.2 billion yuan (7892亿元), a year-on-year increase of 12.3%.
- The 2026 Government Work Report explicitly called for actively developing elderly human resources, formulating measures to promote high-quality development of the silver economy, and improving support policies for elderly products, pension finance, and relocation-based elderly care (旅居养老).

The article outlines four key pillars for transforming "养老" into "享老":
1. **Product Innovation (产品创新)**: Developing health products (portable health monitors, smart medication reminders), integrating "aging-friendly" (适老化) and "smart" designs to bridge the digital divide, and creating tiered product systems for low-age (recreation/entertainment), middle-age, and high-age/disabled seniors (care/mobility assistance).
2. **Service Upgrade (服务升级)**: Building a multi-integrated service system combining home-based, community-based, institutional, and relocation-based elder care; developing a "15-minute elder care service circle" (15分钟养老服务圈); deepening "medical-geriatric integration" (医养结合) and "health-geriatric integration" (康养结合); enriching spiritual and cultural services through senior universities, community cultural stations, and social platforms to combat loneliness.
3. **Industry Integration (产业融合)**: Cross-sector integration with tourism (travel + eldercare), technology (smart monitoring, virtual experiences like "cloud tours" of museums), finance (pension annuities, long-term care insurance, age-friendly banking channels), and sports (adaptive fitness facilities, tai chi, gateball) to enable "all-round enjoyment of old age."
4. **Policy Support (政策护航)**: Relevant policies including the "National Medium and Long-term Plan for Actively Responding to Population Aging," the "14th Five-Year Plan for National Aging Services and Elderly Care Service System Development," and the "Opinions on Developing the Silver Economy and Improving Elderly Welfare." The State Council Executive Meeting before the 2026 Two Sessions specifically studied advancing the silver economy and elderly care services. The article calls for strengthening institutional supply in industry support, pension finance, quality supervision, and talent training, as well as cracking down on false advertising and inferior products.

The article concludes that the silver economy connects people's livelihoods with industrial development, and transforming "养老" to "享老" is not only a livelihood issue but also a major topic for advancing Chinese-style modernization.
</summary>

URL: https://m.chinairn.com/hyzx/20260807/175150990.shtml

SUMMARY:
<summary>
This is a Chinese market research portal (中研普华/ChinaIRN) page featuring a detailed industry analysis report titled "2026—2030年装配式建筑'十五五'产业链全景调研及投资环境深度剖析" (2026-2030 Prefabricated Construction '15th Five-Year' Industrial Chain Panoramic Research and Investment Environment Analysis), published 2026-08-07.

KEY REPORT CONTENT (Prefabricated Construction):

1. Competitiveness Analysis: The prefabricated construction industry has extremely low concentration (PC prefab component segment CR3 below 3%), characterized as "big industry, small companies." Three tiers have emerged: (a) comprehensive construction giants like China State Construction (CSCEC) with EPC general contracting power but slowed growth from traditional housing; (b) professional steel structure leaders like Honglu Steel Structure benefiting from industrial plant and multi-story steel structure penetration but squeezed by intelligent transformation costs; (c) numerous regional PC plants and decoration component companies dependent on local government projects with weak anti-cyclical ability.

2. Regional Competitiveness: Yangtze River Delta, Pearl River Delta, and Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei are high-penetration regions. Guangdong leverages Shenzhen's "Intelligent Construction Pilot City" status and port advantages for modular building exports; Zhejiang and Shanghai lead in prefabricated decoration and BIM review; Anhui absorbs Yangtze River Delta PC overcapacity via steel and logistics costs. Inland provinces rely on mandatory construction proportion policies but lack design institute coordination and skilled industrial workers.

3. Core Capability Dimensions: Future competitiveness depends on four compound capabilities: (a) integrated design-production-construction (EMPC) delivery; (b) multi-system switching (steel/PC/wood); (c) factory flexible manufacturing and carbon footprint accounting; (d) overseas modular certification (EU CE, Middle East GCC).

4. Industrial Chain: Upstream (steel, cement, aggregates, PC production lines, welding robots, MES systems) - profits shifting from "selling materials" to "selling certification" (green building materials labels, carbon labels). Midstream (PC prefab components, steel structures, prefabricated interior decoration) - PC plants face 200km transport radius economics; prefabricated decoration growing faster than main structures; integration trend of component makers acquiring design institutes and construction teams. Downstream (real estate, local government platforms, industrial park operators, overseas general contractors) - affordable housing and public buildings have stable payment conditions; commercial housing faces slow collections due to developer credit risk; overseas demand growing (Shenzhen port activity houses exports up nearly 20% in first 4 months; Middle East reconstruction and Southeast Asian urbanization driving "whole building modules" replacing single components).

5. Industry Trends: (a) Shift from "assembly" to "intelligent construction" - BIM forward design, component RFID tracking, digital twins, welding robot clusters; (b) Green low-carbon as hard constraint - carbon footprint reports required with components, green power usage ratios affecting bidding eligibility; (c) Steel structure and modularization accelerating in parallel - box modular upgrading from "temporary buildings" to "permanent buildings" with 50-year design life; (d) Export evolving from selling components to selling systems - "Chinese design + local compliance + remote operation."

6. Investment Strategy: (a) Avoid red ocean manufacturing, target high-stickiness segments: prefabricated decoration components (high repurchase, avoids cement cycle), steel structure intelligent production lines (domestic substitution + export), BIM and component traceability SaaS (asset-light); (b) Follow urban renewal and port cities - focus on Yangtze/Pearl River Delta with intelligent construction pilot status (Shenzhen, Suzhou, Hangzhou, Hefei); (c) Screening criteria: EMPC capability, green building certification access, MES integration with design data; for Honglu-type secondary market stocks, monitor intelligent investment cost ratios falling in 2027-2028 and overseas revenue share thresholds; (d) Risk boundaries: policy "mandatory proportion" rollback creating demand vacuum; real estate developer liquidation causing receivables impairment; EU/US anti-subsidy investigations on modular buildings; recommend 30%+ allocation to real-estate-decoupled scenarios (industrial, infrastructure, export, public buildings).

2. **Key path for high-quality development of real estate and construction**: The traditional "three highs" (high debt, high leverage, high turnover) model collapsed after 2021; 2025 new housing sales equaled only half of 2020 levels. The construction industry generated 32 trillion yuan output in 2024 with 50+ million workers
3. **Serving economic development transformation**: "Good housing" can activate consumption, drive upstream/downstream industrial upgrades (green materials, digital construction, construction robots, smart property management), create several trillion-yuan new industries, and enhance asset value resilience
4. **Necessary requirement for people-centered development**: Restores housing's role from "investment target" to "life container," restores people's agency in housing, and enhances human capital investment

3. **Construction process**: Integrate material conditions with spiritual experience; emphasize property services, community services, and public services matched with hardware

5. **Improve operation and maintenance services** — Establish full-lifecycle safety management mechanisms, improve property services including elderly care, childcare, meal services and housekeeping, and build smart community information platforms.
6. **Renovate existing housing** — Progress urban village and dilapidated housing renovation, old residential community upgrades, energy-saving retrofits, utility pipeline renewal (gas, water, heating, drainage, fire protection), and encourage trade-in, original-site rebuild, and modular construction approaches; promote prefabricated decoration and integrated kitchens/bathrooms.
7. **Strengthen technology empowerment** — Conduct basic research and key technology breakthroughs, establish enterprise-led innovation platforms, build technology achievement databases, and promote smart home products and digital household development.
8. **Improve industrial support** — Transform real estate and construction enterprises into integrated "good house" builders, create industrial clusters covering building materials, home furnishing, and appliances, pilot green building growth points, and standardize building components.

This is a Sina Finance news digest (dated June 1, 2026) containing two major market news stories with analyst commentary, sourced from Guorong Securities Information.

**Story 1: Urban Renewal "15th Five-Year Plan" (2026-2030) Released**

The State Council issued the "Urban Renewal 15th Five-Year Plan," setting targets for urban renewal work through 2030, including goals for high-quality living spaces, 14 major projects and actions (including "good housing" construction/renovation, complete community construction, old street/factory area upgrades, and municipal infrastructure improvements). Experts project the plan will activate related industrial chains and bring long-term investment opportunities. Zhang Wenzhong, Deputy Chairman of the China Urban Planning Society, noted that renovation of old residential areas, factories, and inefficient industrial parks/office buildings will spawn new business forms and drive smart industries (IoT, digital economy), with the urban renewal market capacity during the "15th Five-Year" period estimated to exceed 15 trillion yuan.

Key quantitative targets from the plan include: renovating ~500,000 sets of dilapidated urban housing, starting renovation of ~115,000 old residential communities, ~4,000 urban village renovations, ~1,500 old street/factory area upgrades, 128,000 hectares of new/expanded sports facilities, 20,000 hectares of urban park green space improvements, 365,000 km of underground pipeline renovation, and 50,000 existing emergency shelters upgraded. The underground pipeline segment alone (gas, water supply, drainage, heating) involves ~600,000 km over five years with ~4 trillion yuan investment (with expert Yan Yuejin estimating 5 trillion yuan for this segment alone). Total market capacity is estimated at 15-20 trillion yuan, compared to ~2.9 trillion yuan invested in urban renewal in 2024. Analysts note urban renewal differs from real estate's "fast turnover/debt financing" model, relying instead on "long-term holding, stable cash flow."

**Story 2: AI Toys - Global Sales Boom, China's 100-Billion-Yuan AI Toy Sector Rises**

As Children's Day approaches, toy sales are in peak season. Yiwu, Zhejiang has 3,000+ toy market operators exporting to 200+ countries. From January to April 2026, Yiwu toy exports reached 8.27 billion yuan, up 11.6% year-over-year. AI smart toys are attracting consumers with interactivity, fun, and educational value. A toy company in Yuyao, Zhejiang reported orders booked through September-October with continuous new orders. China's AI toy market was ~29 billion yuan in 2025, projected to exceed 100 billion yuan by 2030 (up from ~24.6 billion in 2024). Globally, AI toy penetration was only 15.82% in 2025, with forecasts of 364-580 billion USD by 2030 (14-20% CAGR), possibly exceeding 600 billion USD by 2034, with penetration rising from under 16% to over 24% by 2030. # 城市更新“十五五”规划出炉 将带动十万亿元级投资

2026-05-29 10:29:03  来源：经济参考报

城市是现代化建设的重要载体、人民幸福生活的重要空间。5月28日，国务院印发《城市更新“十五五”规划》（以下简称《规划》），为全国城市更新工作划定了清晰的“施工图”和“验收表”。

  根据《规划》，到2030年，城市更新行动取得重要进展，城市开发建设方式转型初见成效，安全发展基础更加牢固，服务效能不断提高，人居环境明显改善，新旧动能加快转换，文化遗产有效保护，风貌特色更加彰显，治理水平大幅提高，城市成为人民群众高品质生活的空间。到2035年，城市更新体制机制更加完善，城市结构优化、动能转换、品质提升、绿色转型、文脉赓续、治理增效取得显著成效，创新、宜居、美丽、韧性、文明、智慧的现代化人民城市基本建成。

  具体来看，《规划》以量化指标的形式明确了“十五五”时期城市更新的具体目标。住房安居方面，将改造城镇危旧房约50万套（间），新开工改造城镇老旧小区约11.5万个，城中村改造约4000个。公共空间方面，将改造提升老旧街区厂区约1500个，新建及改扩建体育场地面积12.8万公顷，改造提升城市公园绿地2万公顷。安全韧性方面，将完成城市地下管网改造36.5万公里，改造存量应急避难场所5万个，城镇房屋基础信息数字化率将达到95%以上。

  据多家机构测算，“十五五”期间城市更新市场总容量预计达15万亿元至20万亿元。这一政策红利将全面激活相关产业链，带来长期投资机遇。中信建投证券研报表示，高质量开展城市更新对打造高品质的住宅、宜居的城市空间、便利的周边配套提出更高的要求，产品力强、布局核心城市的房企有望深度参与到高质量城市更新工作中。在银河证券看来，城市发展转向存量提质增效阶段，与城市更新、老旧小区改造等相关的建筑施工、规划咨询、检验检测、装修装饰等板块将受益。

  58同城研究院院长张波表示，《规划》的出台，标志着城市更新步入制度化、长效化、市场化的新阶段。城市更新正从单一的物理空间改造，向“空间+产业+消费”复合驱动转型，对房地产市场影响深远。

  上海易居房地产研究院副院长严跃进指出，当前城市更新已进入全面加速期，既为城市高质量发展注入持久动力，也为实体经济与资本市场带来广阔机遇。严跃进预计，城市更新直接带动建筑、建材、工程机械、规划设计等上下游产业链发展，仅地下管网一项就将达5万亿元。老旧小区、城中村、危旧房的改造，也将持续拉动装修装饰、家居建材、电梯等行业增长。

  根据《规划》，推动老旧街区厂区、低效产业园区、低效楼宇等转型升级，优化提升传统产业，培育壮大新兴产业和未来产业，因地制宜发展新质生产力，提升城市产业创新活力。发展智能建造，培育现代化建筑产业链。推动消费基础设施改造升级，发展首发经济、银发经济、冰雪经济、低空经济、赛事经济、体验经济等。

  严跃进表示，城市更新不是简单的“拆旧建新”，而是通过空间重构激活消费潜能。老旧街区、厂区改造为文创园区、特色商业街区，将直接带动餐饮、零售、文娱等业态繁荣；体育场地、公园绿地的改造提升，则为体育消费、亲子消费、银发消费、休闲消费等创造新场景，进一步拓展城市消费的广度与深度。

  由于城市更新涉及面广、资金需求大，《规划》在政策支持层面也拿出了“干货”。

  在投融资方面，《规划》构建可持续的城市建设运营投融资体系。明确允许通过地方政府专项债券支持符合条件的城市更新项目建设，支持用作项目资本金；对风险可控、商业可持续、符合条件的项目，允许采用综合开发、银团贷款、项目投资等市场化模式给予支持。

  推动符合条件的城市更新项目发行基础设施领域不动产投资信托基金（REITs）、资产证券化产品等；支持符合条件的城市更新企业发行公司债券、中期票据。

  同时，按照谁受益、谁出资原则，充分发挥市场机制作用，构建政府、市场、居民资金合理共担机制。规范实施政府和社会资本合作新机制，鼓励民营企业积极参与城市基础设施建设运营。稳慎推进公用事业价格改革。更大力度支持盘活存量土地。例如，推动土地用途和建筑功能依法合理转换；鼓励多主体合作改造。合理降低土地整合、置换、联合开发中的税费负担。规范长期租赁、先租后让、弹性年期供应等土地供应方式，支持带方案出让。

  从“开发”到“更新”，从“有没有”到“好不好”，随着数万亿投资稳步落地、新消费场景次第开花、新产业空间拔节生长，城市更新的综合效益将在经济、社会、生态等多个维度持续释放，为高质量发展注入持久动力。（记者 梁倩）

On May 28, 2026, China's State Council issued the "Urban Renewal 15th Five-Year Plan" (《城市更新"十五五"规划》), providing a clear blueprint and evaluation framework for urban renewal work nationwide. According to multiple institutional estimates, the urban renewal market during the "15th Five-Year Plan" period (2026-2030) is expected to reach 15-20 trillion yuan (approximately 10 trillion yuan level investment).

Key targets by 2030 include: transformation of approximately 500,000 sets of dilapidated urban housing, renovation of about 115,000 old residential communities, and redevelopment of about 4,000 urban villages. For public spaces, the plan calls for upgrading about 1,500 old streets/factory zones, building or expanding 128,000 hectares of sports venues, and upgrading 20,000 hectares of urban park green spaces. For safety and resilience, 365,000 km of underground pipelines will be renovated, 50,000 existing emergency shelters upgraded, and digitalization of urban housing basic information will reach 95% or higher.

The plan establishes long-term goals through 2035: completing modernization of cities characterized by innovation, livability, beauty, resilience, civilization, and intelligence.

On financing, the plan supports: local government special bonds for qualifying urban renewal projects (including as project capital), commercial sustainable projects via comprehensive development, syndicated loans, and project investment models; REITs and asset securitization for qualifying projects; corporate bonds and medium-term notes for qualifying urban renewal companies. It also establishes a reasonable cost-sharing mechanism among government, market, and residents based on the "who benefits, who contributes" principle, encourages private enterprises to participate in urban infrastructure construction and operations, and promotes land supply reforms including long-term leasing, lease-before-sale, and flexible term supply.

Expert insights: Zhang Bo (Dean of 58.com City Research Institute) noted the plan marks urban renewal entering an institutionalized, long-term, market-oriented stage, shifting from physical space transformation to a "space + industry + consumption" compound drive. Yan Yuejin (Vice President of Shanghai E-House Real Estate Research Institute) estimated underground pipeline works alone will reach 5 trillion yuan, with direct benefits to construction, building materials, engineering machinery, planning/design, decoration, home furnishings, and elevator industries. CITIC Construction Investment Securities noted real estate companies with strong product capabilities and core city presence will benefit from high-quality urban renewal participation. Galaxy Securities highlighted benefits for construction, planning consulting, inspection/testing, and decoration sectors.

The plan also emphasizes upgrading old streets, factory zones, low-efficiency industrial parks and buildings, developing intelligent construction and modern construction industry chains, and promoting consumption infrastructure upgrades including first-release economy, silver economy, ice/snow economy, low-altitude economy, event economy, and experience economy.

推动符合条件的城市更新项目发行基础设施领域不动产投资信托基金（REITs）、资产证券化产品等；支持符合条件的城市更新企业发行公司债券、中期票据。

同时，按照谁受益、谁出资原则，充分发挥市场机制作用，构建政府、市场、居民资金合理共担机制。规范实施政府和社会资本合作新机制，鼓励民营企业积极参与城市基础设施建设运营。稳慎推进公用事业价格改革。更大力度支持盘活存量土地。例如，推动土地用途和建筑功能依法合理转换；鼓励多主体合作改造。合理降低土地整合、置换、联合开发中的税费负担。规范长期租赁、先租后让、弹性年期供应等土地供应方式，支持带方案出让。

从“开发”到“更新”，从“有没有”到“好不好”，随着数万亿投资稳步落地、新消费场景次第开花、新产业空间拔节生长，城市更新的综合效益将在经济、社会、生态等多个维度持续释放，为高质量发展注入持久动力。（记者 梁倩）

args.summary:
On May 28, 2026, China's State Council issued the "Urban Renewal '15th Five-Year Plan'" (《城市更新"十五五"规划》), establishing a clear roadmap for national urban renewal work. The plan sets two-phase goals: by 2030, urban renewal actions should achieve significant progress with improved development transformation, safety foundations, services, living environments, and governance; by 2035, a modern people's city that is innovative, livable, beautiful, resilient, civilized, and smart should be basically completed.

Quantitative targets for the 2026-2030 period include: renovating approximately 500,000 sets of old/dangerous urban housing, starting renovation of ~115,000 old residential communities, and ~4,000 urban villages; upgrading ~1,500 old street districts and factories; building/expanding 128,000 hectares of sports venues and upgrading 20,000 hectares of urban park green space; completing 365,000 km of underground pipeline renovation; renovating 50,000 emergency shelters; and achieving 95%+ digitalization of urban housing basic information.

Multiple institutions estimate the total urban renewal market during the "15th Five-Year Plan" period at 15-20 trillion yuan, with underground pipeline works alone projected at 5 trillion yuan. The plan enables local government special bonds to support eligible projects (including as project capital), permits comprehensive development, syndicated loans, and project investment market models, supports REITs and asset securitization for qualifying projects, and encourages corporate bonds and medium-term notes. It establishes shared funding mechanisms among government, market, and residents, encourages private enterprise participation in urban infrastructure, and promotes land use flexibility including reasonable conversion of land purposes, long-term leasing, lease-before-sale, and flexible tenure supply.

The plan emphasizes transforming old street districts, low-efficiency industrial parks, and low-efficiency buildings, developing smart construction, and promoting consumption infrastructure upgrades covering first-release economy, silver economy, ice/snow economy, low-altitude economy, event economy, and experience economy. Expert Yan Yuejin (Shanghai E-House Real Estate Research Institute) noted urban renewal is shifting from simple "demolition and rebuilding" to space restructuring that activates consumption potential, directly benefiting downstream industries including construction, building materials, engineering machinery, planning and design, renovation/decoration, home building materials, and elevators. Zhang Bo (58.com City Research Institute) stated the plan marks urban renewal entering an institutionalized, long-term, market-oriented new stage, transitioning from single physical space renovation to "space + industry + consumption" composite transformation with profound impacts on the real estate market.

城市更新“十五五”规划是[中华人民共和国国务院](https://baike.baidu.com/item/%E4%B8%AD%E5%8D%8E%E4%BA%BA%E6%B0%91%E5%85%B1%E5%92%8C%E5%9B%BD%E5%9B%BD%E5%8A%A1%E9%99%A2/117550?fromModule=lemma_inlink)为推进城市更新工作制定的国家级规划。2026年5月15日由[国务院常务会议](https://baike.baidu.com/item/%E5%9B%BD%E5%8A%A1%E9%99%A2%E5%B8%B8%E5%8A%A1%E4%BC%9A%E8%AE%AE/6254315?fromModule=lemma_inlink)审议通过，5月22日正式印发。 [1-2] [7] [21] [23] [26]

该规划是我国首个国家层面的城市更新顶层设计，明确了未来5年城市更新的时间表、任务书和路线图，设置了包括城镇危旧房改造、城镇老旧小区改造等在内的10项主要指标，部署了23项重点任务和14项重大工程。 [13] [20] [22] [24]规划要求构建中央统筹、省负总责、城市抓落实的工作格局。 [2] [7] [23]规划明确了23项重点任务及10项量化指标，包括新开工改造城镇老旧小区11.5万个、更新城镇危旧房约50万套、改造老旧街区厂区1500个、推进4000个[城中村改造](https://baike.baidu.com/item/%E5%9F%8E%E4%B8%AD%E6%9D%91%E6%94%B9%E9%80%A0/4635347?fromModule=lemma_inlink)、建设改造[城市地下管网](https://baike.baidu.com/item/%E5%9F%8E%E5%B8%82%E5%9C%B0%E4%B8%8B%E7%AE%A1%E7%BD%91/67703024?fromModule=lemma_inlink)36.5万公里、新建及改扩建体育场地12.8万公顷、城镇房屋基础信息数字化率达95%以上。 [19-20] [22] [24-25]

规划发布后，全国至少有27个省份已陆续发布地方“十五五”规划纲要作出部署。 [6]2026年6月7日[国务院新闻办公室](https://baike.baidu.com/item/%E5%9B%BD%E5%8A%A1%E9%99%A2%E6%96%B0%E9%97%BB%E5%8A%9E%E5%85%AC%E5%AE%A4/2219586?fromModule=lemma_inlink)举行政策例行吹风会解读规划内容。 [10] [12] [14] [20][财政部](https://baike.baidu.com/item/%E8%B4%A2%E6%94%BF%E9%83%A8/1250873?fromModule=lemma_inlink)明确2024年起累计支持50个重点城市实施城市更新行动先行先试；国家发展改革委2026年安排[中央预算内投资](https://baike.baidu.com/item/%E4%B8%AD%E5%A4%AE%E9%A2%84%E7%AE%97%E5%86%85%E6%8A%95%E8%B5%84/68433334?fromModule=lemma_inlink)城市更新专项资金970亿元支持城镇老旧小区改造等项目，并通过[超长期特别国债](https://baike.baidu.com/item/%E8%B6%85%E9%95%BF%E6%9C%9F%E7%89%B9%E5%88%AB%E5%9B%BD%E5%80%BA/64133108?fromModule=lemma_inlink)安排1600亿元支持城市地下管网建设改造。 [16-17] [20] [25]全国多地启动存量房收储行动，超过70个城市的地方国有企业开始收购主城区存量二手房用于转化为[保障性住房](https://baike.baidu.com/item/%E4%BF%9D%E9%9A%9C%E6%80%A7%E4%BD%8F%E6%88%BF/1094670?fromModule=lemma_inlink)。 [11]

## 发布背景

播报

编辑

中央城市工作会议以来，各地区各部门深入贯彻党中央决策部署，采取一系列推进城市高质量发展的举措，城市工作取得新进展。当前中国城市发展正从大规模增量扩张阶段转向存量提质增效为主的阶段。要把城市更新摆在突出位置，坚持远近结合、突出重点，有力有序推进各项工作，建设创新、宜居、美丽、韧性、文明、智慧的现代化人民城市。要落实好城市更新重点任务，培育壮大城市发展新动能，营造高品质城市生活空间，推动城市发展[绿色低碳](https://baike.baidu.com/item/%E7%BB%BF%E8%89%B2%E4%BD%8E%E7%A2%B3/65444678?fromModule=lemma_inlink)转型，增强城市安全韧性，促进城市文化繁荣发展，提升城市治理能力水平。要健全城市更新实施机制，完善政策支持体系，构建可持续的城市更新模式。 [1]

住房城乡建设部副部长[秦海翔](https://baike.baidu.com/item/%E7%A7%A6%E6%B5%B7%E7%BF%94/4617113?fromModule=lemma_inlink)在吹风会上进一步明确，根据规划部署，“十五五”期间将新开工改造城镇老旧小区11.5万个。 [17]

## 内容全文

播报

编辑

城市更新“十五五”规划

城市是现代化建设的重要载体、人民幸福生活的重要空间。为贯彻落实党中央、国务院关于高质量推进城市更新的决策部署，根据《[中华人民共和国国民经济和社会发展第十五个五年规划纲要](https://baike.baidu.com/item/%E4%B8%AD%E5%8D%8E%E4%BA%BA%E6%B0%91%E5%85%B1%E5%92%8C%E5%9B%BD%E5%9B%BD%E6%B0%91%E7%BB%8F%E6%B5%8E%E5%92%8C%E7%A4%BE%E4%BC%9A%E5%8F%91%E5%B1%95%E7%AC%AC%E5%8D%81%E4%BA%94%E4%B8%AA%E4%BA%94%E5%B9%B4%E8%A7%84%E5%88%92%E7%BA%B2%E8%A6%81/65462241?fromModule=lemma_inlink)》，制定本规划。

总体要求

一、总体要求

坚持以习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想为指导，深入贯彻党的二十大和二十届历次全会精神，认真落实四中全会部署，全面贯彻习近平总书记关于城市工作的重要论述，完整准确全面贯彻新发展理念，坚持稳中求进工作总基调，坚持以人民为中心，坚持系统观念，坚持规划引领，坚持统筹发展和安全，坚持保护第一、应保尽保、以用促保，因地制宜、分类指导，尽力而为、量力而行，建立可持续的城市更新体制机制和政策法规，高质量推进城市更新，为建设现代化人民城市提供坚实基础。

到2030年，[城市更新](https://baike.baidu.com/item/%E5%9F%8E%E5%B8%82%E6%9B%B4%E6%96%B0/10235138?fromModule=lemma_inlink)行动取得重要进展，城市开发建设方式转型初见成效，安全发展基础更加牢固，服务效能不断提高，人居环境明显改善，新旧动能加快转换，文化遗产有效保护，风貌特色更加彰显，治理水平大幅提高，城市成为人民群众高品质生活的空间。到2035年，城市更新体制机制更加完善，城市结构优化、动能转换、品质提升、绿色转型、文脉赓续、治理增效取得显著成效，创新、宜居、美丽、韧性、文明、智慧的现代化人民城市基本建成。

[](https://baike.baidu.com/pic/%E5%9F%8E%E5%B8%82%E6%9B%B4%E6%96%B0%E2%80%9C%E5%8D%81%E4%BA%94%E4%BA%94%E2%80%9D%E8%A7%84%E5%88%92/67792834/0/adaf2edda3cc7cd98d105a943c5c363fb80e7bec3b73?fr=lemma&fromModule=lemma_content-image "专栏 1 “十五五”时期城市更新主要指标")专栏 1 “十五五”时期城市更新主要指标

发展新动能

二、培育壮大城市发展新动能

（一）增强城市发展动力

推动城市特色化发展。落实区域重大战略，因地制宜实施城市更新，优化现代化城市体系。推进超大特大城市治理现代化，以城市群、都市圈为依托构建大中小城市协调发展格局。坚持城乡融合发展，推进宜居县城建设，开展县城体检，因地制宜发展小城镇，加强边境小城镇建设，推动城镇基础设施和公共服务向乡村延伸覆盖。

精心培育创新生态。推动老旧街区厂区、低效产业园区、低效楼宇等转型升级，优化提升传统产业，培育壮大新兴产业和未来产业，因地制宜发展新质生产力，提升城市产业创新活力。发展智能建造，培育现代化建筑产业链。推动消费基础设施改造升级，发展首发经济、银发经济、冰雪经济、低空经济、赛事经济、体验经济等。培育国际消费中心城市。

（二）激活城市存量资源潜力

全面摸清城市存量资产资源底数，推动已供未开发土地和在建项目分类处置，盘活闲置低效的老旧厂房、商业办公用房、商品住房、公房等。加快构建房地产发展新模式，完善商品房开发、融资、销售等基础制度。优化保障性住房供给，强化城镇低收入住房困难家庭住房保障，更好满足住房困难且收入不高的工薪群体基本住房需求，逐步解决新市民、青年等群体的阶段性住房困难。因城施策增加改善性住房供给，规范发展住房租赁市场。促进房地产开发企业转型发展、参与城市更新。深化住房公积金制度改革，扩大使用范围，着力满足缴存人不同阶段的多样化住房需求，支持灵活就业人员参加住房公积金制度。加强和规范存量城市基础设施资产管理。

（三）提升城市对外开放合作水平

支持有条件的城市承担重大外事外交活动，吸引有影响力的国际组织落户。建设一批国际门户枢纽城市和区域性开放节点城市。发挥世界城市日、全球可持续发展城市奖（上海奖）等作用，加强在联合国人居署等多边合作框架下的城市更新国际交流合作。推进高质量共建“一带一路”，支持建筑企业按市场化原则参与国际合作，提升中国建造品牌国际影响力。

城市生活空间

三、营造高品质城市生活空间

（一）推进“好房子”建设

实施房屋品质提升工程，兼顾增量建设与存量更新，全链条提升[住房](https://baike.baidu.com/item/%E4%BD%8F%E6%88%BF/289826?fromModule=lemma_inlink)标准、设计、材料、建造、运维水平，建设改造安全舒适绿色智慧的“[好房子](https://baike.baidu.com/item/%E5%A5%BD%E6%88%BF%E5%AD%90/65474280?fromModule=lemma_inlink)”。鼓励居民开展既有住房装修和局部升级改造，推广[装配式装修](https://baike.baidu.com/item/%E8%A3%85%E9%85%8D%E5%BC%8F%E8%A3%85%E4%BF%AE/20165565?fromModule=lemma_inlink)和适老化、无障碍改造，应用性能优异的[新型建材](https://baike.baidu.com/item/%E6%96%B0%E5%9E%8B%E5%BB%BA%E6%9D%90/4958068?fromModule=lemma_inlink)。在新建、改造住宅项目中开展数字家庭建设，丰富数字家庭应用场景。

[](https://baike.baidu.com/pic/%E5%9F%8E%E5%B8%82%E6%9B%B4%E6%96%B0%E2%80%9C%E5%8D%81%E4%BA%94%E4%BA%94%E2%80%9D%E8%A7%84%E5%88%92/67792834/0/8694a4c27d1ed21b0ef4aff8ab33cac451da81cb9123?fr=lemma&fromModule=lemma_content-image "专栏3 “好房子”建设改造工程")专栏3 “好房子”建设改造工程

[](https://baike.baidu.com/pic/%E5%9F%8E%E5%B8%82%E6%9B%B4%E6%96%B0%E2%80%9C%E5%8D%81%E4%BA%94%E4%BA%94%E2%80%9D%E8%A7%84%E5%88%92/67792834/0/1b4c510fd9f9d72a60591503d2773f34349b033b0d22?fr=lemma&fromModule=lemma_content-image "住宅隔声性能提升材料-好房子建设示意图")住宅隔声性能提升材料-好房子建设示意图

（二）持续推动城镇老旧小区改造

重点对建成20年及以上的城镇[住宅小区](https://baike.baidu.com/item/%E4%BD%8F%E5%AE%85%E5%B0%8F%E5%8C%BA/5787880?fromModule=lemma_inlink)开展专项体检，聚焦补齐基础设施短板、提升服务功能和环境品质实施针对性改造。支持具备条件的楼栋加装电梯。结合改造同步完善长效管理机制，提高管理维护水平。

[](https://baike.baidu.com/pic/%E5%9F%8E%E5%B8%82%E6%9B%B4%E6%96%B0%E2%80%9C%E5%8D%81%E4%BA%94%E4%BA%94%E2%80%9D%E8%A7%84%E5%88%92/67792834/0/0df431adcbef76094b36f99f2880b4cc7cd98d103024?fr=lemma&fromModule=lemma_content-image "楼板隔声材料-城镇老旧小区改造示意图")楼板隔声材料-城镇老旧小区改造示意图

（三）加快建设完整社区

完善社区基本[公共服务设施](https://baike.baidu.com/item/%E5%85%AC%E5%85%B1%E6%9C%8D%E5%8A%A1%E8%AE%BE%E6%96%BD/623893?fromModule=lemma_inlink)，逐步补齐便民商业服务设施短板。完善城市社区嵌入式服务设施，推动一刻钟便民生活圈建设扩围升级。加强社区配套基础设施建设改造，优化提升公共活动场地、公共绿地和慢行系统，因地制宜增设健身休闲运动场所，推进社区服务智能化。

（四）推进老旧街区厂区改造提升

改造提升老旧商业街区、生活街区，完善功能布局，补齐[基础设施](https://baike.baidu.com/item/%E5%9F%BA%E7%A1%80%E8%AE%BE%E6%96%BD/3831695?fromModule=lemma_inlink)和[公共服务](https://baike.baidu.com/item/%E5%85%AC%E5%85%B1%E6%9C%8D%E5%8A%A1/5268657?fromModule=lemma_inlink)短板，优化交通组织，提升[公共空间](https://baike.baidu.com/item/%E5%85%AC%E5%85%B1%E7%A9%BA%E9%97%B4/5127770?fromModule=lemma_inlink)品质，丰富文商旅体展等融合业态，创新沉浸式体验等多元消费场景。实施老旧交通枢纽与周边街区一体化更新改造。推动老旧厂区功能转换，完善厂区及周边配套设施，优化景观环境，加强工业遗产保护利用，盘活利用闲置低效厂区、厂房和设施，植入新业态新功能。鼓励以市场化方式推动老旧厂区改造提升。

（五）提升城市公共服务品质

充分利用存量闲置房屋和低效用地，优先补齐民生领域公共服务设施短板。推动养老机构提质增效，支持有条件的医疗卫生机构开展医养结合服务。建设改造托育服务设施，发展普惠托育和托幼一体化服务。完善全民阅读设施等公共文化服务设施，建设新型公共文化空间。建设改造“小而美”的全民健身场地设施，推动乒乓球等群众喜爱的运动项目进社区、进公园，举办群众身边的赛事活动。整治提升背街小巷环境，开展小微公共空间改造，加快公共场所适老化、无障碍环境建设改造，建设儿童友好空间。

（六）完善城市综合交通体系

优化城市快速路立交和出入口设置，改造瓶颈路段和节点，完善次支路网，实施道路微循环改造工程。严格规范城市轨道交通规划建设，推动轨道交通场站及周边一体化改造。优化城市货运网络规划设计，健全分级配送设施体系。实施老城区停车补短板行动，鼓励建设集约化停车设施，推进停车设施建设改造，按规定配建充电设施。持续开展人员密集区域停车综合治理行动。

绿色低碳转型

四、推动城市发展绿色低碳转型

（一）修复城市生态系统

建设连续完整的城市生态基础设施体系。加快修复受损山体、采煤沉陷区和特大矿坑。加强建设用地土壤污染风险管控和修复，有序推进污染地块环境修复与开发建设衔接。持续深化工业园区水污染整治，强化入河排污口排查整治，建设排污口分级分类监管体系。巩固城市黑臭水体治理成效。保护修复城市湿地，因地制宜推进渠化河道改造，建设幸福河湖、美丽河湖。统筹推进[城市噪声](https://baike.baidu.com/item/%E5%9F%8E%E5%B8%82%E5%99%AA%E5%A3%B0/9175201?fromModule=lemma_inlink)等污染治理。结合地方实际，因地制宜、量力而行，完善城市绿地系统，推动公园绿地开放共享，加强古树名木保护。

[](https://baike.baidu.com/pic/%E5%9F%8E%E5%B8%82%E6%9B%B4%E6%96%B0%E2%80%9C%E5%8D%81%E4%BA%94%E4%BA%94%E2%80%9D%E8%A7%84%E5%88%92/67792834/0/d31b0ef41bd5ad6eddc4e6f587962edbb6fd52669625?fr=lemma&fromModule=lemma_content-image "城市噪声")城市噪声

（二）加快城市建设绿色转型

推动高耗能公共建筑改造升级，鼓励采用合同能源管理等市场化节约能源服务。大力发展[绿色建筑](https://baike.baidu.com/item/%E7%BB%BF%E8%89%B2%E5%BB%BA%E7%AD%91/2588?fromModule=lemma_inlink)，推动超低能耗建筑、[低碳建筑](https://baike.baidu.com/item/%E4%BD%8E%E7%A2%B3%E5%BB%BA%E7%AD%91/3811746?fromModule=lemma_inlink)规模化发展。建立建筑能效等级制度，优化建筑用能结构。推广绿色设计，持续推进[绿色建材](https://baike.baidu.com/item/%E7%BB%BF%E8%89%B2%E5%BB%BA%E6%9D%90/2444627?fromModule=lemma_inlink)评价认证和推广应用，稳步发展装配式建筑。推广[绿色施工](https://baike.baidu.com/item/%E7%BB%BF%E8%89%B2%E6%96%BD%E5%B7%A5/7324448?fromModule=lemma_inlink)，鼓励使用新能源车辆和机械，加强[建筑材料](https://baike.baidu.com/item/%E5%BB%BA%E7%AD%91%E6%9D%90%E6%96%99/6320438?fromModule=lemma_inlink)循环利用，促进建筑垃圾减量化，严格管控施工扬尘和[噪声](https://baike.baidu.com/item/%E5%99%AA%E5%A3%B0/1405144?fromModule=lemma_inlink)。

（三）践行绿色低碳生活方式

推进城市节水，建设海绵城市。深化气候适应型城市建设。加快城市污水收集处理设施补短板，推动建立厂网统筹的建设运维长效机制。持续完善垃圾分类收集和处理设施体系，健全城市生活垃圾资源回收利用体系。推进城市生活垃圾收运网络与再生资源回收网络融合。推动建筑垃圾利用处置设施建设，开展存量建筑垃圾专项整治。倡导绿色低碳出行，优化公交线网和站点布局，建设公交停车场等设施，建设改造人行道、非机动车道，构建城市绿色慢行交通系统。

城市安全韧性

五、增强城市安全韧性

（一）有序推进危旧房改造

对城市C、D级危险住房和非成套住房建档立卡并动态更新。用好中央补助资金、地方政府专项债券等，加快拆除改造D级危险住房，精准消除安全隐患。支持老旧住房自主更新、原拆原建，探索可持续运营模式。优先支持资源枯竭城市实施危旧房改造等项目。稳步推进预制板房屋治理改造和地震易发区房屋抗震加固。加强建筑保温材料管理。

（二）稳步推进城中村更新改造

采取拆除新建、整治提升、拆整结合等多种方式，对群众需求迫切、城市安全和社会治理隐患多的[城中村](https://baike.baidu.com/item/%E5%9F%8E%E4%B8%AD%E6%9D%91/4172812?fromModule=lemma_inlink)优先实施改造。严格落实“一项目两方案”，做到征收补偿到位、项目资金平衡。加强安置房规划设计和建设管理，确保合理工期和建设质量。

（三）加强城市基础设施建设改造

实施城市地下管网和综合管廊建设改造。开展城市地下管网体检，加快实施燃气、供水、排水、污水、热力等老旧管网更新改造，因地制宜推动地下综合管廊建设。推进城市燃气管道老化更新改造，优化燃气设施布局，加强上游供给。推进供水设施更新改造，提高城市供水安全保障能力。完善城市排水防涝体系，健全洪涝联排联调机制。深入实施城镇供热“温暖工程”，推动老旧供热管网和设施设备更新改造，有序推进供热计量改造。统筹国防动员和城市地下管网建设改造。

[](https://baike.baidu.com/pic/%E5%9F%8E%E5%B8%82%E6%9B%B4%E6%96%B0%E2%80%9C%E5%8D%81%E4%BA%94%E4%BA%94%E2%80%9D%E8%A7%84%E5%88%92/67792834/0/d4628535e5dde71190ef1dbba2b2d91b9d16fdfacb73?fr=lemma&fromModule=lemma_content-image "市政基础设施提升工程")市政基础设施提升工程

加快城市基础设施生命线安全工程建设。强化对城市燃气、供水、排水、桥梁、隧道、热力、管廊等城市基础设施运行风险的实时监测、动态预警，及早发现和管控风险隐患。提高城市基础设施生命线安全工程建设运行质效，健全监测体系，完善风险隐患高效协同处置机制。

（四）提升风险防控和应急保障能力

支持盘活闲置低效资源，推进城市平急两用公共基础设施建设，完善医疗应急服务体系和应急物流体系。建设改造应急避难场所，推动平急两用公共基础设施及多种应急资源共建共用，完善应急避难功能，构建多层次应急避难场所体系。加强公共消防设施建设。提升街道、社区应急救援基础设施保障水平。强化城市道路桥梁安全管理，对超过设计使用年限或经专业检测发现存在安全隐患的D、E级桥梁隧道进行更新改造。提升工程防火保障能力，加强工程防火和消防审验技术力量，建设国家工程防火实验室和防火能力仿真模拟自主平台。提升高层建筑火灾防范和救援能力。

城市文化发展

六、促进城市文化繁荣发展

（一）推进资源调查

建立健全“先调查后建设”的保护前置机制。加强与全国文物普查衔接，开展老城区、老街区专项调查，形成历史文化名城、街区和历史地段、历史建筑潜在对象名单，开展预保护。按规定认定公布国家历史文化名城，推进省级和市县级保护对象认定公布，规范设立标志牌，开展数字化信息采集和测绘建档。

（二）加强整体保护

整体保护历史文化名城、街区和文物及周边风貌。开展历史文化名城、街区保护提升工程。开展不可移动文物、历史建筑和传统民居修缮。建立以居民为主体的保护实施机制，提升人居环境品质。坚决防止大拆大建、拆真建假。

（三）推动活化利用

活化利用不可移动文物、历史建筑、工业遗产、历史文化街区、历史地段等，在严格保护其核心价值与风貌的前提下，引入新业态新功能，以文化赋能产业发展，丰富城市文化体验、旅游休闲功能，同时避免过度商业化、同质化。

（四）塑造城市特色风貌

完善城市风貌管理制度。加强城市更新重点地区、重要地段风貌管控，保护城市独特的历史文脉、人文地理、自然景观，植根中华优秀传统文化，塑造特色风貌。开展城市设计并作为城市风貌管理的重要依据，提出建筑高度、体量、风格、色彩等控制要求，从整体平面和立体空间上统筹建筑布局、协调景观风貌、提升空间品质。

加强建筑设计管理。落实“适用、经济、绿色、美观”建筑方针，推动建筑设计传承创新，更好体现中华美学和时代风尚。强化优秀建筑设计作品正向引导作用，提升建筑设计质量。严格限制超高层建筑。提高既有建筑改造设计水平。提升住宅建筑设计品质。

城市治理能力

七、提升城市治理能力水平

（一）完善城市治理工作体系

建立健全城市管理统筹协调机制，发挥好“一委一办一平台”作用，加强对城市治理工作的指挥调度、组织协调、监督评价，依托数智化手段提升城市运行和治理效能。探索社区党组织领导下的居委会、业委会、物业服务企业协调运行新模式。完善居民、企业、群团组织、社会组织参与城市治理制度机制，发挥志愿服务作用，拓宽新就业群体参与渠道。

（二）推动城市治理重心和配套资源下沉

发挥党建引领基层治理协调机制作用，加强跨部门工作统筹和协同联动。坚持和发展新时代“枫桥经验”，深入开展城市管理进社区工作，运用“吹哨报到”、“接诉即办”等工作机制，及时解决群众急难愁盼问题。加强物业服务市场监管，推动“物业服务进家庭”，鼓励有条件的物业服务企业向养老、托育、家政、文化、健康、助残等领域延伸。推动住宅小区建设骑手友好社区。加强互嵌式社区建设。

（三）推动城市治理智慧化精细化

推进城市全域数字化转型，建设城市信息模型（CIM）基础平台，打造集约统一、数据融合、高效协同的城市数字底座。完善CIM基础数据库和标准体系，丰富拓展“CIM+”在城市更新中的应用场景。推进房屋建筑和市政设施赋码，建设国家房屋建筑和市政设施基础信息库。推动区块链赋能住房交易、产权登记等。健全国家、省、城市三级城市运行管理服务平台体系，推动城市运行“一网统管”。

城市更新体系

八、建立城市更新政策体系

（一）健全城市更新实施机制

全面开展城市体检，建立完善“专项规划—片区策划—项目实施方案”的实施体系，健全城市体检与城市更新一体化推进机制。建立城市更新项目库，推动项目常态化储备和动态调整。建立与建筑功能转换和混合利用需求相适应的规划调整机制，完善城市更新工程建设项目审批管理制度。规范开展城市更新示范项目创建。实施城市更新统计调查制度。按照简明精准、务实管用原则，研究建立科学的城市发展评价体系。

（二）构建可持续的城市建设运营投融资体系

完善财政支持政策。通过中央预算内投资等对符合条件的项目给予支持。中央财政支持实施城市更新行动。允许通过地方政府专项债券支持符合条件的城市更新项目建设，支持用作项目资本金。地方政府加大财政投入，在确保完成国家任务的前提下，推进相关资金整合和统筹使用。落实城市更新相关税费减免政策。

优化金融支持措施。发挥各类金融机构作用，引导金融机构按照市场化、法治化原则，在业务范围内为城市更新项目提供金融服务，不得新增地方政府隐性债务。对风险可控、商业可持续、符合条件的项目，允许采用综合开发、银团贷款、项目投资等市场化模式给予支持。探索金融支持城镇老旧住房自主更新、原拆原建的有效举措。

积极吸引社会资本参与。推动符合条件的城市更新项目发行基础设施领域不动产投资信托基金（REITs）、资产证券化产品等。支持符合条件的城市更新企业发行公司债券、中期票据等。按照谁受益、谁出资原则，充分发挥市场机制作用，构建政府、市场、居民资金合理共担机制。规范实施政府和社会资本合作新机制，鼓励民营企业积极参与城市基础设施建设运营。稳慎推进公用事业价格改革。

（三）更大力度支持盘活存量土地

规范空间复合利用。增强国土空间详细规划适应性，制定土地混合开发和空间复合利用的正面清单并明确规划管控要求，建立健全国土空间用途管制和规划许可制度，推行多部门并联审批和联合监管，推动土地用途和建筑功能依法合理转换。利用存量土地、房产资源发展国家支持产业、行业的，可享受一定年期内不改变用地主体和规划条件的过渡期政策，过渡期原则上不超过5年；过渡期满办理土地有偿使用手续的，可采取租赁或协议出让方式。

鼓励多主体合作改造。合理降低土地整合、置换、联合开发中的税费负担。规范长期租赁、先租后让、弹性年期供应等土地供应方式，支持带方案出让。依法稳妥推进工商业用地使用权续期。完善地价计收规则。

优化不动产登记服务。健全与混合利用、功能兼容、立体开发相适应的不动产登记规则。按照土地使用权地上地下空间分层供应情况，依法依规办理登记。灵活采用预告登记、按户首次登记等登记类型提供服务。因历史文化、特色风貌保护等原因需要保留建筑物、构筑物的，支持在确保安全的前提下，简化不动产登记申请材料。

（四）建立房屋全生命周期安全管理制度

建立房屋安全体检制度，对超过一定年限的房屋建筑定期开展体检，及时发现和处置安全隐患。建立房屋安全管理资金制度，统筹现有房屋安全管理相关资金，支持拓展资金来源，为房屋全生命周期安全管理提供资金保障。建立房屋质量安全保险制度，以市场化方式提高房屋安全保障能力。

（五）构建多主体协同参与机制

政府统筹协调各类存量资源，支持国有企业、民营企业参与城市更新。发挥街道、社区作用，建立居民、产权人、企业等多方主体参与机制。建立城市更新专家库和智库，引导专业技术力量提供全过程咨询服务。培育城市更新专业化运营机构。完善城市更新社会风险评估、矛盾化解处置机制。

（六）健全法律法规标准体系

研究修订城市房地产管理法、建筑法等法律。研究制定城市更新、城镇住房保障、城镇房屋安全管理、城乡历史文化保护传承、城镇地下管线管理、建设工程消防设计审查验收等相关法规，修订住房公积金管理条例、物业管理条例、历史文化名城名镇名村保护条例等法规。支持有立法权的地方出台城市更新相关地方性法规。研究健全城市更新标准体系，完善城市设计、城市体检、城市更新专项规划、历史文化保护、城市基础设施、市容环境卫生等标准。鼓励制修订符合地方需要的技术标准。

（七）强化科技人才支撑作用

开展可持续城市更新关键技术和装备攻关。加强城市更新科研力量。建设城市更新重点领域科技创新平台基地。支持有条件的高校、职业学校开设城市更新相关学科专业。支持高校、科研院所、骨干企业联合培养城市更新工程硕博士、卓越工程师。开展城市更新领域特色学院建设，实施城市更新领域职业教育高技能人才集群培养计划。实施建设英才培养计划。将城市更新作为干部教育培训重要内容，加强城市更新工作培训，定期组织领导干部培训，加强专业技术人员培训。

组织实施

九、组织实施

坚持和加强党中央集中统一领导，构建中央统筹、省负总责、城市抓落实的工作格局。各省（自治区、直辖市）人民政府要明确本地区城市更新的目标、任务和措施。各城市人民政府要切实履行责任，细化落实本规划确定的重点任务，确保顺利实施。要加大宣传力度，广泛宣传新时代党领导城市更新的创新政策和工作成效，积极营造良好氛围。住房城乡建设部要会同有关部门加强统筹指导和协调支持，开展规划实施情况动态监测、中期评估和总结评估。重大事项及时按程序向党中央、国务院请示报告。

### 解读二

改造城镇危旧房约50万套（间）

城市更新是推动城市高质量发展、不断满足人民美好生活需要的重要举措。

“十四五”时期，我国城市人居环境质量进一步提升，人民群众在城市生活得更方便、更舒心、更美好。具体来看，“十四五”时期，我国加装电梯12.9万部，增设停车位340多万个、养老托育等社区服务设施6.4万个；更新改造供水、燃气、供热等地下管网84万公里；打造口袋公园1.8万多个、城市绿道2.5万公里。

今后五年，城市更新有哪些重点任务？

“十五五”规划纲要提出，在地下管网建设改造方面，要建设改造城镇燃气管网约20万公里、排水管网约17.5万公里、供水管网约17.5万公里、污水管网约10万公里、供热管网约12万公里，同步推进智慧化改造。因地制宜建设综合管廊。

在宜居安居水平提升方面，要以国有土地上C、D级危险住房等为重点，改造城镇危旧房约50万套（间）。改造老旧小区约11.5万个。

在老旧街区厂区改造方面，要推动老旧街区功能转换、业态升级、活力提升，以市场化方式盘活利用闲置低效厂区、厂房和设施，更新改造约1500个老旧街区厂区。

此次会议明确，要把城市更新摆在突出位置，坚持远近结合、突出重点，有力有序推进各项工作，建设创新、宜居、美丽、韧性、文明、智慧的现代化人民城市。上海易居房地产研究院副院长严跃进表示，会议对城市更新的相关部署，意味着城市更新工作将进入提速阶段。预计接下来各地将进一步加大相关工作力度，持续推进城市更新各项任务。

营造高品质城市生活空间

会议提出要落实好城市更新重点任务，培育壮大城市发展新动能，营造高品质城市生活空间，推动城市发展绿色低碳转型，增强城市安全韧性，促进城市文化繁荣发展，提升城市治理能力水平。要健全城市更新实施机制，完善政策支持体系，构建可持续的城市更新模式。

培育壮大城市发展新动能。近年来，全国多个城市积极培育新产业、新业态，以市场化方式推动老旧厂区更新改造。例如，老旧厂区变身文创园区、废弃铁路成为创业街区，城市更新与产业升级深度融合，为城市发展注入新动能。

营造高品质城市生活空间。老旧小区加装电梯、完善“一老一小”服务设施、织密口袋公园和绿道网络，眼下正在稳步推进的一系列民生工程，着眼于提高居民生活品质、提升居民的幸福感。

推动城市发展绿色低碳转型。存量建筑节能改造、推广绿色建材等，我国的城市更新工作始终将“绿色”放在重要位置。中国建筑材料联合会数据显示，今年一季度绿色建材营收规模突破610亿元，继续保持12%的较快增长。

增强城市安全韧性。根据中共中央办公厅、国务院办公厅印发的《关于持续推进城市更新行动的意见》，我国将加快拆除改造D级危险住房，通过加固、改建、重建等多种方式，积极稳妥实施国有土地上C级危险住房和国有企事业单位非成套住房改造。分类分批对存在抗震安全隐患且具备加固价值的城镇房屋进行抗震加固。

促进城市文化繁荣发展。《关于持续推进城市更新行动的意见》明确，落实“老城不能再拆”的要求，全面调查老城及其历史文化街区，摸清城镇老旧小区、老旧街区、老旧厂区文化遗产资源底数，划定最严格的保护范围。

更多政策举措加快出台落地

《关于持续推进城市更新行动的意见》提出，到2030年，城市更新行动实施取得重要进展，城市更新体制机制不断完善，城市开发建设方式转型初见成效等。

2026年以来，城市更新工作正在稳步推进。

1月，自然资源部联合住房和城乡建设部发布《关于进一步支持城市更新行动若干措施的通知》，推出增强详细规划适应性、优化过渡期支持政策等举措。财政部、住房和城乡建设部日前发布通知，2026年中央财政继续支持部分城市实施城市更新行动。今年一季度，城市更新相关专项债券发行接近1200亿元。

根据全国住房城乡建设工作会议部署，2026年我国将高质量开展城市更新，抓好城市体检、更新试点，实施一批民生工程、发展工程、安全工程。近期，住房和城乡建设部透露，地级及以上城市和县级市今年要全面开展城市体检工作，加快实现住房、小区、街区、城区4个维度体检全覆盖。

全国多省份已陆续发布地方“十五五”规划纲要，划定未来五年城市更新发展目标和实施重点。截至目前，至少有27个省份对城市更新作出部署。近期，各地城市更新相关政策相继出台，涉及公布实施城市更新条例、印发未来五年城市更新行动方案、推出城市更新政策激励工具箱等多个方面，加快推进城市更新行动落地见效。 [6]

### 好房子

5月15日召开的国务院常务会议，审议通过《城市更新“十五五”规划》，并作出一系列重要部署。会议指出，当前我国城市发展正从大规模增量扩张阶段转向存量提质增效为主的阶段；要把城市更新摆在突出位置。这为我国高质量开展城市更新锚定了方向。此次会议同时明确了城市更新的重点任务，其中提出推动城市发展绿色低碳转型。

在“双碳”目标深入推进与城市更新高质量推进的今天，如何让承载着城市记忆的“老房子”通过绿色低碳理念蝶变为宜居可持续的“好房子”，已成为建筑领域碳达峰的关键路径。既有建筑低碳改造全面融入城市更新行动，正成为提升城市品质的重要抓手。

推动改造从“倡导”走向“应改尽改”

今年《政府工作报告》提出“坚持城市内涵式发展”“高质量推进城市更新”。“支持老旧住房自主更新、原拆原建”写入《中共中央 国务院关于推动城市高质量发展的意见》。“十五五”规划《纲要》明确提出“高质量推进城市更新”。

政策对城市更新的支撑是撬动绿色低碳转型的关键支点。

中国建筑节能协会副秘书长付宇表示：“建筑领域是我国能源消费和碳排放大户。”根据中国建筑节能协会最新数据，建筑领域碳排放量约占全国能源消费总量的22.1%。

截至2023年，我国建筑总面积已达716亿平方米，其中城镇公共建筑与居住建筑碳排放，占建筑运行阶段碳排放总量的82%。目前国内非节能建筑存量占比仍偏高，普遍存在建筑围护结构保温性能不足、老旧用能设备亟待改造、日常运行管理缺位等突出问题。既有建筑改造任务依然艰巨。

付宇表示：“我们正站在一个存量提质时代的历史起点，改造潜力巨大，急需政策与标准的双轮驱动。”

从政策层面来看，我国对建筑节能领域的推动力度持续加大，顶层规划清晰明确、导向鲜明。2024年3月，国务院印发《推动大规模设备更新和消费品以旧换新行动方案》，提出推进存量建筑节能改造；2025年8月，中共中央、国务院印发《关于推动城市高质量发展的意见》，明确要求加大既有建筑节能改造力度；今年初，住房和城乡建设部发布关于提升住房品质的意见提出“老房子改造为‘好房子’取得明显进展”的目标，并明确推动既有住房更新改造的任务。一系列国家战略部署与政策文件接续出台，形成了强有力的政策牵引和制度支撑。

面对这一挑战，国家层面已构建起多层次、立体化的政策框架体系。付宇将其概括为“四维驱动模型”：目标驱动方面，从顶层设计到“好房子”建设的具体要求，相关目标体系清晰且责任层层分解；法规驱动方面，形成了“行政法规统领、部门规章支撑、地方立法补充、国家标准兜底”的四层体系，其中北京、上海、深圳等地的地方立法赋予了更强执行力，如北京规定公共建筑连续两年用能超过限定值80%即须强制改造；经济驱动方面，资金工具箱日趋丰富，地方财政补贴正从“普惠式”向“绩效式”转变。例如，重庆按碳减排率补贴、上海按能耗下降量补贴等创新模式涌现；市场驱动方面，CCER（国家核证自愿减排量）机制为改造项目开辟了“节能收益+碳收益”的新模式，合同能源管理和绿色电力交易等市场化工具也在持续发力。

“在技术标准体系层面，我国已初步形成纵向分层、横向覆盖、分类指导的既有建筑节能改造体系。”付宇认为，当前标准正在从单纯的节能走向全面的低碳乃至零碳，从关注设计性能走向全流程、全生命周期的管控。各地也在因地制宜探索差异化路径：上海以立法先行，建立强大的能耗监测平台网络；深圳以标准驱动，在团体标准中融入碳排放评价方法；杭州则推行分类管理模式，将改造项目分为改扩建、装饰装修、设备优化三类，分别提出差异化要求。

从鼓励“倡导”走向“应改尽改”已是大势所趋。规模化推进仍面临存量巨大、经济性不足、标准协同不够、人才储备欠缺、碳排放数据基础薄弱等瓶颈。因此，应将改造要求深度纳入城市更新法规，建立建筑碳配额制度，加快碳排放数据库与标准协同。

从单一技术到系统集成

政策与标准为改造提供了方向与底线，而真正让“老房子”焕发新生，则需要技术集成与金融创新的协同发力。

中建方程科技与设计管理部副经理吴克辛从投资开发企业的实操视角，分享了既有居住社区绿色低碳改造与绿色金融协同创新的经验。以乌鲁木齐老旧小区改造项目为例，该项目是新疆维吾尔自治区和乌鲁木齐两级政府的重点民生工程，通过对能源系统、空间整合、外墙、交通系统、供电网、智慧安防和停车场等进行综合改造，获得了既有居住社区改造金级认证，并入选全国首批绿色低碳改造社区案例。

“城市更新的特点是环节多、收益率低、周期长、收益回报不确定，需要从单一融资走向综合金融服务。”因此，吴克辛提出，改造项目需匹配多元化绿色金融工具，通过绿色债券、可持续挂钩债等创新融资，将绿色资产资本化，破解投资大、周期长、回报慢难题，实现“节能收益+碳收益+环境价值”多元回报。

既有建筑改造不同于新建建筑，其技术集成面临更复杂的挑战。中国城市建设研究院绿色建筑总工程师徐力指出，“新建建筑以目标为导向，而既有建筑改造则是以问题为导向，改造难度是新建建筑的数倍”。

她从技术路径角度分析认为：“建筑降碳需围绕‘减排=开源+节流=主动式节能+被动式节能+可再生能源替代’的标准路径展开”。以合肥园博园为例，该项目由原骆岗机场航站楼改造而成，项目充分利用原有空间布局，采用轻钢结构替换屋顶减轻荷载，通过植入中庭和立体庭院改善采光与环境，既保留了建筑的历史记忆，又注入了新的功能活力。

既有建筑改造遵循“被动式节能+主动式高效+可再生能源利用”核心路径，从建筑本体、能源系统、智慧运维三方面实现降碳。徐力认为，当前挑战在于技术适配性、标准衔接与运维数据缺失，未来将向技术集成化、用能低碳化、运维智慧化升级。

从各自为战到系统合力

既有建筑低碳改造不是单一技术或单一主体能够推动的工作，而是一个涉及政策、技术集成、市场机制以及用户参与的系统性工程。

“最大的制度性障碍是碎片化问题。”付宇直言，无论从责任主体还是改造收益来看，碎片化都是当前面临的核心挑战。老旧小区产权分散，业主、物业、街道、电力等各方“各管一段”，谁来牵头改造、谁来申请协调、节能收益如何分配等关键问题尚未形成清晰的解决机制。她以上海静安区为例，该区通过建立区政府、楼宇业主、节能服务公司三方统管模式，有效解决了公共建筑改造的责任分散问题。

在资金与商业模式方面，吴克辛认为不存在“最容易跑通”的统一模式，“每个项目都有各自的特点和匹配的资源，需要遵循实事求是的原则”。“从投资收益角度，有些项目难度虽大，但通过方法创新和系统统筹方案可能取得更高回报；有些项目风险不大但收益很低，达不到投资考核指标，企业同样不会碰。”

在技术落地方面应考虑多方面因素。中国中元国际工程有限公司副所长任君以热源设计为切口介绍，技术路线的确定应统筹考虑能源参数、资源禀赋、经济性等多方面因素，可考虑分不同气候分区制定居住建筑改造原则：严寒、寒冷地区以集中供热低碳改造为主；夏热冬冷地区以社区级分布式低碳能源为主；夏热冬暖地区聚焦高效供冷设备升级。低碳能源普遍存在间歇性强、资源与需求空间错配、供水温度较低等特点，需在源端与末端之间做好匹配，“两者需要相互奔赴，才能形成完整合理的系统”。

深圳市建筑科学研究院高级工程师彭锐结合多地调研经验指出，顶层设计、算好经济账、强有力的社区领导和居民参与，是改造能否长效的关键。“我们调研发现，不一定是成本很高的低碳技术效果最好，往往是软性层面的措施，比如居民行为引导、可持续运营的商业场景跑通，反而能带来更长久的效果。”

城市更新为既有建筑节能改造带来了重大机遇，业内专家建议，应将低碳改造全面嵌入城市更新立项、规划、资金安排核心环节，通过碳评价与绩效考核绑定，让绿色低碳从“可选项”变为“必选项”，共同推动老房子向安全、宜居、低碳、高品质的好房子升级 [8]。

### 解读三

2026年6月8日，国务院新闻办举行国务院政策例行吹风会，住房城乡建设部等四部门就我国首部国家级城市更新专项规划《城市更新“十五五”规划》作出解读，明确目标任务、细化政策举措、回应社会关切。 [16]

铺展发展蓝图 提升城市品质

当前，我国城镇化正从快速增长期转向稳定发展期，城市发展正从大规模增量扩张阶段转向存量提质增效为主的阶段。住房城乡建设部副部长秦海翔表示，规划明确了城市更新的时间表、任务书和路线图，提出了10项主要指标、23项重点任务、7个方面政策举措、14项重大工程和行动。 [16]

秦海翔表示，规划聚焦增进人民福祉，从人民群众最关心的居住品质、公共服务、人居环境、基础设施等方面设置了10项规划指标；对标创新、宜居、美丽、韧性、文明、智慧的现代化人民城市建设目标，部署了6方面重点任务。 [16]

在任务部署上，“十五五”期间将实施一批民生工程、发展工程、安全工程。

具体来看，民生工程方面，重点是推进“好房子”建设，持续改造城镇老旧小区，加快建设完整社区，提升城市公共服务品质；发展工程方面，重点是增强城市发展动力，激活城市存量资源潜力，推进老旧街区、厂区改造提升，为新产业、新业态发展创造条件；安全工程方面，重点是推进危旧房、城中村改造，加强城市基础设施建设改造，提升风险防控和应急保障能力。 [16]

地下管网是城市运行“生命线”。秦海翔说，“十五五”期间，将继续建设改造城市地下管网约77万公里，其中，燃气管网约20万公里、排水管网约17.5万公里、供水管网约17.5万公里、污水管网约10万公里、供热管网约12万公里。在增强城市安全韧性的同时，也将带动有效投资。 [16]

强化要素保障 破解更新难题

城市更新资金需求量巨大，“钱从哪来”是各方关注焦点。

财政部经济建设司司长郭方明介绍，2024年起，财政部会同住房城乡建设部启动支持部分重点城市实施城市更新行动，连续三年累计支持50个重点城市先行先试。中央财政对东、中、西部每个城市分别给予定额补助。同时，统筹各项资金渠道，支持城市更新重点任务。“十五五”期间，中央财政还将保持较大的支持力度，并不断优化政策设计，提高资金使用效益。 [16]

国家发展改革委固定资产投资司负责人关鹏表示，2026年将安排中央预算内投资城市更新专项资金970亿元，重点支持城镇老旧小区改造、城市危旧房改造等项目，惠及居民约800万户。同时，在“两重”建设中安排超长期特别国债资金1600亿元，比上一年增加250亿元，支持城市燃气、排水、供水、供热等地下管网建设改造。 [16]

关鹏说，下一步，将优先支持公共安全和民生保障类工程，统筹支持老旧街区厂区改造提升等发展类工程，并在创新投融资机制方面鼓励民营企业积极参与城市基础设施建设运营。 [16]

盘活存量土地和空间资源是城市更新的核心任务之一。自然资源部国土空间规划局局长谢海霞介绍，要按照规划提出的“全面摸清城市存量资产资源底数”的要求，通过建立上下贯通的自然资源管理和国土空间规划“一张图”，来强化存量资源的摸排，弄清底数，在“一张图”上对存量资源进行全生命周期的管理，打通部门数据共享，切实能够把资产管起来，让资源用起来，使城市活起来。 [16]

守文脉优治理 赋能城市发展

历史文化是城市的灵魂，也是城市魅力的关键。陈少鹏表示，在城市更新中保护和传承好历史文化，是必须履行好的责任。要在城市更新全过程、各环节加强城市历史文化遗产保护，做到保护第一、应保尽保、以用促保。

具体措施包括：继续做好资源调查，“十五五”期间，将持续开展老城区、老街区专项调查，摸清历史文化街区、历史地段、历史建筑等资源底数，对符合条件的要及时认定公布，同时做好建档、测绘、挂牌等工作。做好整体保护，开展历史文化名城、街区保护提升工程，建立以居民为主体的保护实施机制，在保护历史风貌的同时消除安全隐患、提升基础设施水平。做好活化利用，将活化利用不可移动文物、历史建筑、工业遗产、历史文化街区、历史地段等，引入新业态新动能，以文化赋能城市发展。 [16]

提升城市治理能力水平也是规划的重点任务。陈少鹏说，要健全城市治理工作体系，发挥好“一委一办一平台”作用，不断完善居民、企业、群团组织、社会组织共同参与的城市治理制度机制。完善社区服务机制，发挥党建引领基层治理协调机制作用，推动城市治理重心和配套资源下沉，深入开展城市管理进社区工作。推动城市治理智慧化精细化。 [16]

盘活存量土地和空间资源是城市更新的核心任务之一。自然资源部国土空间规划局局长谢海霞介绍，要按照规划提出的“全面摸清城市存量资产资源底数”的要求，通过建立上下贯通的自然资源管理和国土空间规划“一张图”，来强化存量资源的摸排，弄清底数，在“一张图”上对存量资源进行全生命周期的管理，打通部门数据共享，切实能够把资产管起来，让资源用起来，使城市活起来。

守文脉优治理 赋能城市发展

历史文化是城市的灵魂，也是城市魅力的关键。陈少鹏表示，在城市更新中保护和传承好历史文化，是必须履行好的责任。要在城市更新全过程、各环节加强城市历史文化遗产保护，做到保护第一、应保尽保、以用促保。

具体措施包括：继续做好资源调查，“十五五”期间，将持续开展老城区、老街区专项调查，摸清历史文化街区、历史地段、历史建筑等资源底数，对符合条件的要及时认定公布，同时做好建档、测绘、挂牌等工作。做好整体保护，开展历史文化名城、街区保护提升工程，建立以居民为主体的保护实施机制，在保护历史风貌的同时消除安全隐患、提升基础设施水平。做好活化利用，将活化利用不可移动文物、历史建筑、工业遗产、历史文化街区、历史地段等，引入新业态新动能，以文化赋能城市发展。

提升城市治理能力水平也是规划的重点任务。陈少鹏说，要健全城市治理工作体系，发挥好“一委一办一平台”作用，不断完善居民、企业、群团组织、社会组织共同参与的城市治理制度机制。完善社区服务机制，发挥党建引领基层治理协调机制作用，推动城市治理重心和配套资源下沉，深入开展城市管理进社区工作。推动城市治理智慧化精细化。 [15]

## 实施案例

播报

编辑

2026年5月《城市更新“十五五”规划》发布后，[万科集团](https://baike.baidu.com/item/%E4%B8%87%E7%A7%91%E9%9B%86%E5%9B%A2/1423827?fromModule=lemma_inlink)迅速响应，组织专业部门对现有及拟拓展项目进行系统梳理以寻找发展机遇。2026年6月2日，万科联合杨行资产通过协议出让方式获取上海市宝山区杨行镇老集镇一宗“城中村”改造住宅用地（二期项目）。上海易居房地产研究院副院长[严跃进](https://baike.baidu.com/item/%E4%B8%A5%E8%B7%83%E8%BF%9B/56142631?fromModule=lemma_inlink)分析称，该举措利用上海核心地段和交通优势构建现金流回笼机制以应对债务压力。 [9]

规划发布后，全国多地启动了存量房收储行动。2026年6月，超过70个城市的地方国有企业开始收购主城区存量二手房，用于转化为保障性住房。 [11]

此外，在宏观政策执行层面，国家发展改革委于2026年6月8日召开政策吹风会，明确了规划落实的具体路径。在“硬投资”方面，将优先支持城镇老旧小区改造、城市危旧房改造等公共安全和民生保障类工程，并统筹支持老旧街区（厂区）改造提升等发展类工程；同时，将在“两重”建设中安排[超长期特别国债](https://baike.baidu.com/item/%E8%B6%85%E9%95%BF%E6%9C%9F%E7%89%B9%E5%88%AB%E5%9B%BD%E5%80%BA/64133108?fromModule=lemma_inlink)资金，加力支持城市地下管网建设改造。在“软建设”和投融资机制方面，强调将“人民城市人民建、人民城市为人民”的理念贯穿城市更新项目全过程，完善投入和运营维护机制，并鼓励通过盘活存量资产、创新金融产品等方式吸引社会资本参与。 [12]

此外，在规划发布后的政策落实层面，[财政部](https://baike.baidu.com/item/%E8%B4%A2%E6%94%BF%E9%83%A8/1250873?fromModule=lemma_inlink)、住房城乡建设部等部门也明确了具体支持方向。 [16]2026年6月8日，[国务院新闻办公室](https://baike.baidu.com/item/%E5%9B%BD%E5%8A%A1%E9%99%A2%E6%96%B0%E9%97%BB%E5%8A%9E%E5%85%AC%E5%AE%A4/2219586?fromModule=lemma_inlink)举行政策例行吹风会，财政部经济建设司司长郭方明在会上指出，2024年起，财政部会同住建部启动了支持部分重点城市实施[城市更新行动](https://baike.baidu.com/item/%E5%9F%8E%E5%B8%82%E6%9B%B4%E6%96%B0%E8%A1%8C%E5%8A%A8/61720678?fromModule=lemma_inlink)有关工作，连续3年累计支持北京、上海、沈阳等50个重点城市先行先试，中央财政对东、中、西部每个城市分别给予定额补助。“十五五”期间，这50个城市将按照实施方案确定的工作目标，探索城市更新可复制、可推广的机制。 [17]住房城乡建设部副部长秦海翔在同一吹风会上介绍，《城市更新“十五五”规划》从建设好房子、好小区、好社区、好城区四个方面对提高居民居住和生活品质作出了部署，其中在好小区方面，实施城镇老旧小区改造工程，“十五五”期间将新开工改造城镇老旧小区11.5万个，重点实施房屋品质提升工程。 [16]

## 规划落实

播报

编辑

2026年6月8日，住房城乡建设部建筑节能与科技司司长陈少鹏在国务院新闻办公室举行的国务院政策例行吹风会上说，目前，我国城市地下管网总长度约390万公里，累计建成地下综合管廊约7700公里。住房城乡建设部将会同有关部门落实《城市更新“十五五”规划》部署，指导各地完成好城市基础设施建设改造任务。

一是加快补齐短板。首先是完善城市排水防涝体系，推进排水管渠、泵站、排涝通道、调蓄设施、智慧平台等城市排水设施建设改造，提高设施的建设标准，提升城市排水防涝能力。同时还将继续实施城市的污水管网建设，提升城市生活污水收集处理能力，因地制宜推进城市地下综合管廊建设。

二是持续实施更新改造。对于供水管网，重点是对老化破损的市政配水管网进行更新改造，提高城市供水的安全保障能力。对于燃气管网，重点是改造材质落后、腐蚀严重的市政管道，消除安全隐患。对于供热管网，将重点实施城镇供热“温暖工程”，加快供热老化管线、低效换热站等的更新改造，降低热损失、保障安全运行。

三是实施智能化建设改造。在加快管网建设改造的同时，统筹推进城市基础设施的生命线安全工程建设，实现对城市基础设施运行风险从监测发现到预警处置的全流程闭环管理。

国家发展改革委固定资产投资司负责人关鹏说，近年来，国家发展改革委联合住房城乡建设部，通过超长期特别国债积极支持城市燃气、排水、供水、供热等地下管网建设改造，2026年安排资金规模为1600亿元，比上一年增加250亿元。将在“两重”建设中继续安排超长期特别国债资金，对城市地下管网建设改造项目予以加力支持。 [18]

规划明确了23项重点任务，并拿出了10项量化指标。其中包括：新开工改造城镇老旧小区11.5万个；更新城镇危旧房约50万套；改造老旧街区厂区1500个；推进4000个城中村改造；建设改造城市地下管网36.5万公里；新建及改扩建体育场地12.8万公顷；城镇房屋基础信息数字化率要达到95%以上。2026年中央预算内专项投入970亿元，超长期特别国债1600亿元，重点保障地下管网等安全基建。其次，社会资本积极跟进。街区、园区、厂区等可运营项目全面放开，银行信贷、不动产信托投资基金、资产证券化等工具拓宽融资渠道。最后，居民自主出资。像老旧步梯房加装电梯、危旧房屋自主更新原拆原建，“谁受益、谁出资”，居民的自主出资也必不可少。这样不仅能减轻财政负担，也能确保改造方案符合居民的实际需求。 [19]
